definition_zh: 农业；农学；耕作；农业体系
definition_en: the practice or science of farming, including growing crops and raising animals
core_image: 犁铧翻开的泥土，一垄一垄伸向天边
scene: 清晨的田里，拖拉机沿着垄沟缓慢前行，翻起湿润的泥土。Agriculture still employs most families in the valley.
sceneCN: 这里 agriculture 是「农业」（第 1 个义项：种植作物与饲养牲畜的生产活动）；句意为在这个山谷里，农业仍然养活着大多数家庭。图中可辨识物件：拖拉机、垄沟、泥土。

pos.zh: 名词：农业；农学；耕作

forms.label: 不可数名词（通常无复数）

derivatives.zh: 由 agriculture 加 -al 构成，义为「农业的；农艺的」
由 agriculture 加 -ist 构成，义为「农学家；农业经营者」
由 agri- 加 business 构成，义为「农业综合企业」

senses.title: Farming as a practice
senses.definition: the work and practice of growing crops and raising animals for food and materials
senses.definitionCN: 种植作物、饲养牲畜以获取食物与材料的工作与生产活动
senses.example: Agriculture still employs most families in the valley.
senses.exampleCN: 在这个山谷里，农业仍然养活着大多数家庭。
senses.why: Latin ager meant a field and cultura meant cultivation; agriculture is literally the cultivating of fields.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 ager 意为「田地」，cultura 意为「耕作」；agriculture 字面就是「耕作田地」。

senses.title: The science of farming
senses.definition: the scientific study of farming, including soils, crops, and animal husbandry
senses.definitionCN: 研究耕作、土壤、作物与畜牧的科学
senses.example: She studied agriculture at the provincial university.
senses.exampleCN: 她在省立大学学习农学。
senses.why: The word covers both the work and the study of it, since a science of fields grew out of the fields themselves.
senses.whyCN: 这个词既指劳作，也指对劳作的研究，因为田地的科学本就是从田地里长出来的。

senses.title: A particular way of farming
senses.definition: a specific method or system of cultivating land, such as hillside or dry-land farming
senses.definitionCN: 某种具体的土地利用与耕作方式，如坡地农业或旱地农业
senses.example: Hillside agriculture requires careful terracing.
senses.exampleCN: 坡地耕作需要精心修筑梯田。
senses.why: When fields differ, the cultivating of them differs too; the word names each such way of working the land.
senses.whyCN: 田地不同，耕作方式也就不同；这个词用来指每一种具体的土地利用方式。

senses.title: A region's farming system
senses.definition: the whole farming economy of a region, including its crops, livestock, and trade
senses.definitionCN: 某一地区整体的农业经济，包括作物、牲畜与贸易
senses.example: The island's agriculture depends on steady rainfall.
senses.exampleCN: 这个岛的农业依赖稳定的降雨。
senses.why: A whole region can be seen as one great field, and its farming as one system.
senses.whyCN: 整个地区可以被看作一大片田，而它的农业就是一个体系。

senses.title: The farming sector
senses.definition: the farming industry and the institutions and people concerned with it
senses.definitionCN: 农业产业以及与之相关的机构与人员
senses.example: The ministry of agriculture published its annual report.
senses.exampleCN: 农业部发布了年度报告。
senses.why: Modern states treat farming as a sector with ministries and policies, and the word follows it there.
senses.whyCN: 现代国家把农业当作一个有部委、有政策的部门，这个词也随之进入那个语境。

intro.en: Agriculture joins the Latin words for field and for cultivation.
intro.cn: agriculture 把拉丁语中表示「田地」与「耕作」的两个词连在一起。

items.en: Ager meant a field or a piece of land, and it also gave English acre and agrarian.
items.cn: ager 意为「田地、一块土地」，也生出英语的 acre 与 agrarian。

items.en: Cultura meant tilling, tending, and later care or cultivation of the mind.
items.cn: cultura 意为「耕作、照料」，后来又指心智的培养。

items.en: The compound agricultura named the tilling of fields as a whole occupation.
items.cn: 复合词 agricultura 把耕作田地作为一整套职业来命名。

items.en: English borrowed agriculture for both the work and the skill of farming.
items.cn: 英语借入 agriculture，兼指农耕的劳作与技艺。

items.en: The word widened to the science of farming and to the farming sector of an economy.
items.cn: 词义扩展到农学，以及一个经济体中的农业部门。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words built from agri- and -culture; the near-meaning group gathers kinds of farming.
note.cn: 形近组收由 agri- 与 -culture 构成的词；近义组收不同类型的农牧经营。

entries.definition: An adjective meaning relating to farming or the countryside.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「农业的；农艺的」，指与耕作或乡村有关。

entries.definition: A person who practices or studies farming.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「农学家；农业经营者」，指从事或研究农业的人。

entries.definition: The commercial side of farming, including supply, processing and trade.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「农业综合企业」，指农业的供应、加工与贸易等商业环节。

entries.definition: The activity of growing crops or raising animals on a farm.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「务农；耕作」，指在农场种植作物或饲养牲畜。

entries.definition: The careful management of land, crops, or animals.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「农牧管理」，指对土地、作物或牲畜的精心经营。

entries.definition: The act of preparing land and growing crops on it.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「耕作；栽培」，指整地并种植作物的行为。

normalIntro.en: These hooks tie the word to a field, a plough and the culture of tending land.
normalIntro.cn: 下面几个记忆钩子把这个词与田地、犁铧以及照料土地的「文化」联系起来。

normal.en: AGRI means field: agri + culture is the culture of fields.
normal.cn: agri 意为「田地」：agri 加 culture，就是田地的耕耘之道。

normal.en: Picture a plough turning dark soil into long furrows.
normal.cn: 想象犁铧把深色泥土翻成一道道长沟。

normal.en: Agriculture and culture share a word: both are about tending and growing.
normal.cn: agriculture 与 culture 共用一个词根：两者都关乎照料与生长。

normal.en: Agri appears in acre and agrarian too, all pointing to land.
normal.cn: agri 也出现在 acre 与 agrarian 里，都指向土地。

normal.en: A country's agriculture is its fields plus its farmers plus its markets.
normal.cn: 一个国家的农业，就是它的田地、农民与市场之和。

abstract.en: Agriculture is culture applied to the ground.
abstract.cn: 农业，就是施加在土地上的「文化」。

abstract.en: Every field is a promise that next season will come.
abstract.cn: 每一块田，都是对下一季仍会到来的承诺。

abstract.en: The word treats soil, animals and science as one enterprise.
abstract.cn: 这个词把土壤、牲畜与科学当作同一项事业。

examples.en: Agriculture uses nearly half of the country's fresh water.
examples.cn: 农业用掉了这个国家近一半的淡水。

examples.en: She studied agriculture at the provincial university.
examples.cn: 她在省立大学学习农学。

examples.en: Hillside agriculture requires careful terracing.
examples.cn: 坡地耕作需要精心修筑梯田。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「阿哥，犁，靠它」：阿哥说，犁地靠它，农业就是靠土地吃饭。

root: 拉丁语 ager（田地）与 cultura（耕作）合成 agricultura，字面即「耕作田地」，经法语进入英语，兼指农耕活动、农学与农业部门。

sensesIntro.en: The word covers farming itself, the science of farming, particular methods, a region's farming system and the farming sector.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个词覆盖农耕本身、农学、具体耕作法、地区农业体系以及农业部门。

core.en: CULTIVATING THE FIELD
core.cn: 耕作田地

branches.en: the daily work of farming
branches.cn: 日常的农耕劳作

branches.en: the study of farming
branches.cn: 对农耕的研究

branches.en: a particular way of working land
branches.cn: 某种具体的耕作方式

branches.en: a whole region's farming
branches.cn: 整个地区的农业

branches.en: farming as an industry
branches.cn: 作为产业的农业

intro.en: Agriculture combines two Latin bases, agri- for field and -culture for tending, and each base forms many words.
intro.cn: agriculture 由两个拉丁词基合成：agri- 表「田地」，-culture 表「照料」，每个词基都能构成许多词。

latinIntro.en: Ager and cultura are the Latin sources; English adds -al, -ist and combines agri- with business words.
latinIntro.cn: ager 与 cultura 是拉丁语来源；英语加上 -al、-ist，并把 agri- 与商业类词组合。

items.exampleCN: 去年农产品出口上升了。
这个地区农业资源丰富。

items.meaning: one who farms or studies farming
items.example: The agriculturist tested three new seeds.
items.exampleCN: 这位农学家试种了三种新种子。
农业综合企业主导了当地经济。

items.meaningCN: 农用工业；农产品加工业
items.exampleCN: 农产品加工业雇用许多村民。

items.example: Agroforestry protects the thin hillside soil.
items.exampleCN: 农林复合经营保护了稀薄的山坡土壤。
法律限制了几种农用化学品。

items.meaning: tourism based on farm stays and rural life
items.example: Agrotourism brings extra income to farms.
items.exampleCN: 农业旅游为农场带来额外收入。

definition_zh: 农用化学品（农药、除草剂、化肥等）；农化行业
definition_en: a manufactured chemical used on farmland, such as a pesticide, herbicide or fertiliser; also the industry that produces these substances
core_image: 从化工厂搬到田里的那一袋药
scene: 这片稻田过去靠人工除虫，如今一年要撒好几遍药。Agrochemical use has doubled in ten years.
sceneCN: 这里 agrochemical 是「农用化学品」（第 1 个义项：用于农田的农药与化肥等化学制品）；句意为农用化学品的用量十年间翻了一倍。核心画面是从化工厂搬到田里的那一袋药。

pos.zh: 农用化学品；农药化肥

derivatives.zh: 去掉 agro- 的部分，义为「化学品；化学制品」
agro- 的来源词，义为「农业」
agro- 加 chemistry，义为「农业化学」

senses.title: A chemical made for farm use
senses.definition: a manufactured chemical used on farmland, such as a pesticide, herbicide or fertiliser, to protect or feed crops
senses.definitionCN: 用于农田的人造化学制品，如杀虫剂、除草剂或肥料，用来保护或供养作物
senses.example: The co-op buys agrochemicals in bulk before planting.
senses.exampleCN: 合作社在播种前批量采购农用化学品。
senses.why: Agro- means field and chemical means a substance made by chemistry, so the word simply names chemistry carried out into the fields.
senses.whyCN: agro- 表示田地，chemical 表示化学制成的物质，所以这个词就是「把化学带到田里去」的东西。

senses.title: The farm chemical industry
senses.definition: the sector that produces and sells these substances, used as a mass noun in business and policy writing
senses.definitionCN: 生产与销售这些物质的行业，在商业与政策文本中作总称名词使用
senses.example: The agrochemical sector is dominated by a few global firms.
senses.exampleCN: 农化行业由少数几家全球企业主导。
senses.why: Here the same word shifts from counting bottles to naming the whole trade, exactly as pharmaceutical does in medicine.
senses.whyCN: 这里同一个词从「数瓶子」变成「指整个行业」，正如 pharmaceutical 在医药领域的用法。

intro.en: Agrochemical is a modern compound: the Greek agros, field, joined to chemical, which itself traces back to the old word for the art of metals and drugs.
intro.cn: agrochemical 是一个现代复合词：希腊语 agros「田地」加上 chemical，而 chemical 本身可追溯到表示金属与药物技艺的古老词。

items.en: Greek agros meant a field or open country, the same root that gives agriculture and agrarian.
items.cn: 希腊语 agros 意为田地或旷野，与 agriculture、agrarian 同根。

items.en: Latin ager carried the same meaning, and its stem agr- is what English borrowed as agro-.
items.cn: 拉丁语 ager 意义相同，其词干 agr- 正是英语借作 agro- 的形式。

items.en: Arabic al-kimiya named the art of transmuting substances, and reached Europe through medieval Latin.
items.cn: 阿拉伯语 al-kimiya 指物质转化的技艺，经中世纪拉丁语传入欧洲。

items.en: Scholarly Latin chemicus described someone practising that art, giving English chemical and chemistry.
items.cn: 学术拉丁语 chemicus 指从事该技艺的人，为英语提供 chemical 与 chemistry。

items.en: English joined agro- to chemical in the twentieth century, as industrial farming began to depend on manufactured inputs.
items.cn: 英语在二十世纪把 agro- 与 chemical 拼合，当时工业化农业开始依赖人造投入品。

note.en: The look-alike group keeps the agro- and chem- pieces; the near-meaning group lists the specific products this word covers.
note.cn: 形近组保留 agro- 与 chem- 构件；近义组列出该词涵盖的具体产品。

entries.definition: The practice of farming crops and animals.
entries.definitionCN: 种植作物与饲养动物的生产活动。

entries.definition: Relating to land, farming or country life.
entries.definitionCN: 与土地、农耕或乡村生活有关的。

entries.definition: The science of substances and their reactions.
entries.definitionCN: 研究物质及其反应的科学。

entries.definition: Relating to the chemistry of living things.
entries.definitionCN: 与生物体化学过程有关的。

entries.definition: A substance used to kill pests.
entries.definitionCN: 用来杀灭害虫的物质。

entries.definition: A substance used to kill unwanted plants.
entries.definitionCN: 用来杀灭杂草的物质。

entries.definition: A substance added to soil to help crops grow.
entries.definitionCN: 施入土壤帮助作物生长的物质。

entries.definition: A substance used to destroy fungi.
entries.definitionCN: 用来杀灭真菌的物质。

normalIntro.en: Agrochemical is agro, field, plus chemical: a chemical that works in the field.
normalIntro.cn: agrochemical 就是 agro「田地」加 chemical「化学品」：在田里干活的化学品。

normal.en: Agro- always points at farmland: agriculture, agrarian and agrochemical all start in the fields.
normal.cn: agro- 永远指向农田：agriculture、agrarian、agrochemical 都从田里出发。

normal.en: The word is countable when you mean a product, so say three agrochemicals.
normal.cn: 指具体产品时可数，所以说 three agrochemicals。

normal.en: It is uncountable when you mean the industry, so say the agrochemical sector.
normal.cn: 指行业时不可数，所以说 the agrochemical sector。

normal.en: Pesticide, herbicide and fertiliser are all kinds of agrochemical, not rivals to it.
normal.cn: pesticide、herbicide、fertiliser 都是 agrochemical 的种类，不是它的对立词。

normal.en: Stress falls on chem: agro-CHEM-ical, the same pattern as biochemical.
normal.cn: 重音落在 chem 上：agro-CHEM-ical，与 biochemical 的重音模式相同。

abstract.en: Picture a factory chimney standing at the edge of a rice paddy.
abstract.cn: 想象一根工厂烟囱立在稻田边上。

abstract.en: Imagine a sack labelled with a chemistry formula instead of a grain name.
abstract.cn: 想象一只麻袋，标签上写的是化学式而不是谷物名。

abstract.en: Think of rain washing a field medicine into the river below.
abstract.cn: 想象雨水把田里的药冲进下面的河。

examples.en: Runoff carries agrochemicals into the streams after heavy rain.
examples.cn: 大雨之后，径流把农用化学品带进溪流。

examples.en: The farm cut its agrochemical bill by rotating crops.
examples.cn: 这家农场通过轮作削减了农化开支。

examples.en: Agrochemical residues were found on a third of the samples.
examples.cn: 三分之一的样品检出了农化残留。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「阿格罗凯米扣」——阿格罗（agro）是田，凯米扣（chemical）是化学药：田里用的化学药，就是农用化学品。

root: 希腊语 agros「田地」经拉丁语 ager（词干 agr-）形成组合前缀 agro-，与源自阿拉伯语 al-kimiya 的 chemical 拼合，二十世纪构成 agrochemical，字面即「田地里用的化学品」。

sensesIntro.en: Both senses name the same substances: one counts the products a farmer buys, the other names the industry that makes them, and neither leaves the field.
sensesIntro.cn: 两个义项指的是同一批物质：一个数农民买的产品，一个指生产这些产品的行业，两者都没有离开田地。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: factory chemistry carried into the field
core.cn: 核心意象：把工厂里的化学搬进田里

branches.en: A spray that kills insects on the leaf.
branches.cn: 喷在叶面上杀虫的药剂。

branches.en: A granule that feeds the root.
branches.cn: 给根部供肥的颗粒。

branches.en: A handful of firms supplying whole regions.
branches.cn: 少数几家企业供应整个地区。

branches.en: Policy debates about farm inputs.
branches.cn: 关于农业投入品的政策争论。

branches.en: Both start with chemistry applied to land.
branches.cn: 两者都始于把化学用于土地。

intro.en: Agrochemical joins two productive pieces: agro- fixes the place, the field, and chemical fixes the kind of substance.
intro.cn: agrochemical 拼合了两个能产构件：agro- 确定地点「田地」，chemical 确定物质类别。

latinIntro.en: The field half is Latin ager with stem agr-; the chemical half reached Latin from Arabic al-kimiya.
latinIntro.cn: 「田地」这一半是拉丁语 ager，词干 agr-；「化学」这一半经阿拉伯语 al-kimiya 进入拉丁语。

latinEntries.example: Ager gives the stem agr-.
latinEntries.exampleCN: ager 提供词干 agr-。

latinEntries.example: The genitive agri explains agriculture.
latinEntries.exampleCN: 属格 agri 解释了 agriculture 的拼写。

latinEntries.example: Chemicus stands behind chemical.
latinEntries.exampleCN: chemicus 是 chemical 的来源。

definition_zh: 小病；轻微疾病；不适
definition_en: an illness, especially a mild or chronic one that is not seriously dangerous
core_image: 一件贴身的小毛病，像口袋里揣了太久的小石子
scene: 诊所的候诊室里坐满了老人，护士轻声叫号。The doctor treated every minor ailment with patience.
sceneCN: 这里的 ailment 是「小病、不适」（第 1 个义项：不太严重的疾病）；句意是医生耐心诊治每一种小毛病。

pos.zh: 小病；轻微疾病；慢性不适

derivatives.zh: 基础动词，义为「使苦恼；使患病」
加现在分词后缀 -ing 构成，义为「生病的；境况不佳的」

senses.title: A mild illness
senses.definition: an illness, especially one that is mild or long-standing rather than life-threatening
senses.definitionCN: 一种疾病，尤指不严重或长期缠身而非危及生命的病
senses.example: The doctor treated every minor ailment with patience.
senses.exampleCN: 医生耐心地诊治每一种小毛病。
senses.why: The verb ail means to trouble; the noun names the trouble itself, small and persistent like a stone in the pocket.
senses.whyCN: 动词 ail 意为「使苦恼」；名词指的就是这种苦恼本身，小而缠人，像口袋里的石子。

senses.title: A chronic bodily or mental disorder
senses.definition: a disorder of body or mind that keeps troubling someone over a long period
senses.definitionCN: 长期困扰人的身体或心理失调
senses.example: Modern medicine has remedies for most age-related ailments.
senses.exampleCN: 现代医学对大多数与年龄相关的病痛都有对策。
senses.why: Because the root image is ongoing trouble rather than sudden harm, the word fits conditions that linger rather than strike.
senses.whyCN: 因为词根意象是「持续的困扰」而非突然的伤害，所以这个词适合形容缠绵不去的病况。

intro.en: From a verb meaning to trouble, first the body, then the spirit.
intro.cn: 来自一个表示「使苦恼」的动词，先指身体，后指心灵。

items.en: eglan meant to trouble or afflict, related to egle, troublesome, painful.
items.cn: 古英语 eglan 意为「使苦恼、折磨」，与 egle（麻烦的、痛苦的）同源。

items.en: The verb ailen meant to trouble or afflict, used of bodies and of hearts alike.
items.cn: 中古英语动词 ailen 意为「使苦恼」，既用于身体也用于心灵。

items.en: The noun suffix -ment turned the verb into a thing: the trouble itself, an ailment.
items.cn: 名词后缀 -ment 把动词变成一件事物：苦恼本身，即一种小病。

items.en: The noun appears in English in the fifteenth century, first of bodily complaints.
items.cn: 该名词于十五世纪见于英语文献，最初指身体上的病症。

items.en: Modern English keeps ailment for mild or chronic complaints, while ailing describes a person or business in poor shape.
items.cn: 现代英语用 ailment 指轻微或慢性的病痛，ailing 则形容身体不佳或经营不善的人或机构。

note.en: The first group gathers look-alike kin of the verb ail; the second collects nouns for illness of different weights.
note.cn: 第一组收动词 ail 的形近同族词；第二组收集表示不同轻重疾病的名词。

entries.definition: to trouble or affict someone in body or mind; mostly used in questions like what ails you
entries.definitionCN: 使苦恼；使患病；多用于 what ails you 这类问句

entries.definition: in poor health, or (of a business) struggling
entries.definitionCN: 生病的；（企业等）境况不佳的

entries.definition: a beer-like drink; only similar in sound, not related in origin
entries.definitionCN: 麦芽酒；只是发音相近，词源无关

entries.definition: an illness, especially one reported to a doctor
entries.definitionCN: 疾病；尤指向医生述说的病症

entries.definition: an illness, often a serious or widespread one, sometimes figurative
entries.definitionCN: 疾病；常指严重或流行之病，也可作比喻

entries.definition: a disruption of normal physical or mental function
entries.definitionCN: （身心机能的）紊乱；失调

entries.definition: something that causes pain or suffering, including illness
entries.definitionCN: 痛苦；折磨；也包括病痛

normalIntro.en: ail (trouble) plus -ment (a thing): the thing that troubles you.
normalIntro.cn: ail（使苦恼）加 -ment（表示事物）：那个让你难受的小东西。

normal.en: ailment is the noun form of the verb ail, meaning a minor illness.
normal.cn: ailment 是动词 ail 的名词形式，指小病。

normal.en: -ment builds nouns from verbs, as in treatment and movement.
normal.cn: 后缀 -ment 把动词变成名词，如 treatment、movement。

normal.en: Ailing describes someone in poor health; ailing companies are also said to be sick.
normal.cn: ailing 形容健康不佳；经营不善的公司也说 ailing。

normal.en: Common collocations: a minor ailment, a chronic ailment, age-related ailments.
normal.cn: 常见搭配：a minor ailment、a chronic ailment、age-related ailments。

normal.en: What ails you? asks what troubles you — the ailment is the answer.
normal.cn: What ails you?（你哪里不舒服？）—— ailment 就是那个答案。

abstract.en: Picture a small pebble carried in a shoe: it never stops the journey, but it always nags.
abstract.cn: 想象鞋里的一颗小石子：不挡路，却一直硌脚。

abstract.en: See a shelf of small jars in a country pharmacy, each labelled with a small trouble.
abstract.cn: 想象乡村药铺的一排小药罐，每个罐子上都贴着一种小毛病。

abstract.en: Imagine an old man opening his coat to show not one great wound but many small aches.
abstract.cn: 想象一位老人敞开外衣，里面不是一处大伤，而是许多小小的疼痛。

examples.en: She visited the clinic for a minor ailment.
examples.cn: 她因为一点小病去了诊所。

examples.en: Cold remedies are sold for every common ailment.
examples.cn: 治各种常见小病的药都有出售。

examples.en: Her ailments multiplied as she grew older.
examples.cn: 她上了年纪，病痛也多了起来。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「爱儿闷」——爱儿闷闷不乐，原来是有点小毛病。

root: 源自古英语 eglan「使苦恼」，中古英语动词 ail 保留此义，加名词后缀 -ment 后指「苦恼之事」，即小病、不适。

sensesIntro.en: Both senses grow from one image: a trouble that persists without becoming grave.
sensesIntro.cn: 两个义项都源于同一意象：一种持续存在却不算严重的困扰。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a small persistent trouble, a pebble in the pocket.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个持续的小困扰，像揣在口袋里的石子。

branches.en: The pebble becomes a mild illness that a doctor can name and treat.
branches.cn: 小石子变成一种医生能命名、能治疗的轻微疾病。

branches.en: The pebble stays in the pocket for years: the complaint turns chronic.
branches.cn: 小石子常年留在口袋里：病症转为慢性。

branches.en: The collection of pebbles weighs on the whole person: decline sets in.
branches.cn: 石子越积越多，压垮整个人：衰弱由此开始。

branches.en: The same trouble can sit in the mind: weariness and low spirits.
branches.cn: 同样的困扰也可以落在心里：倦怠与低落。

branches.en: Figuratively, even a sick organization can be said to suffer ailments.
branches.cn: 作比喻时，连不景气的机构也可以说患了「病痛」。

intro.en: A native English root plus a Latin-built noun suffix: one short word, two traditions.
intro.cn: 一个本土英语词根加一个源自拉丁的名词后缀：短短一词，两大传统。

latinIntro.en: The suffix -ment came through French from Latin menta; it builds nouns of action or result.
latinIntro.cn: 后缀 -ment 经法语来自拉丁语 menta，用于构成表示动作或结果的名词。

items.meaning: the result or means of an action
items.meaningCN: 表示动作的结果或手段

items.meaning: the act or manner of treating
a reason given for or against something
an illness; an expression of dissatisfaction

items.example: the root of eglan, to trouble

derivatives.zh: 基础动词，义为「使苦恼；使患病」
加现在分词后缀 -ing 构成，义为「生病的；境况不佳的」

definition_zh: 飞机；航空器；飞行器
definition_en: any vehicle designed to travel through the air, such as an airplane, helicopter, or balloon
core_image: 离开地面、靠机翼与动力留在空中的载具
scene: 跑道上，地勤人员挥手示意放行，引擎声越来越响。The aircraft lifted off the runway and turned toward the sea.
sceneCN: 这里 aircraft 是「航空器、飞机」（第 1 个义项：能在空中飞行的载具）；句意为这架飞机离开跑道，转向海面。

pos.zh: 名词：飞机；航空器；飞行器

derivatives.zh: 由 aircraft 与 carrier 复合而成，义为「航空母舰」
由 aircraft 与 man 复合而成，义为「航空兵；空军士兵」

senses.title: A vehicle that flies
senses.definition: a machine or vehicle designed to travel through the air, including planes, helicopters, and balloons
senses.definitionCN: 设计用于在空中飞行的机器或载具，包括飞机、直升机与气球
senses.example: The aircraft landed safely despite the storm.
senses.exampleCN: 尽管有暴风雨，这架飞机还是安全着陆了。
senses.why: The compound joins the medium to the vessel: a craft made to work in the air.
senses.whyCN: 这个复合词把介质与载具连在一起：为在空中工作而造的船。

senses.title: Flying vehicles as a category
senses.definition: the whole class of flying machines, considered collectively rather than one by one
senses.definitionCN: 所有飞行机器的整体类别，而不是逐架看待
senses.example: Modern aircraft rely on lightweight composite materials.
senses.exampleCN: 现代航空器依赖轻质复合材料。
senses.why: A collective noun lets engineers and regulators speak about the category without naming every type.
senses.whyCN: 集合名词让工程师与监管者不必逐一列举型号，就能谈论整个类别。

senses.title: A military force of flying machines
senses.definition: planes and helicopters regarded as a combat force or unit
senses.definitionCN: 被视为作战力量或单位的飞机与直升机
senses.example: The base keeps a squadron of aircraft ready.
senses.exampleCN: 基地让一个中队的航空器保持待命。
senses.why: In military usage the machine becomes a unit, counted and deployed like ships or tanks.
senses.whyCN: 在军事用法中，机器变成一个单位，像舰船或坦克那样被计数与部署。

intro.en: Aircraft is a modern compound of two old words, air from Greek and craft from Old English.
intro.cn: aircraft 是两个古老词组成的现代复合词：air 来自希腊语，craft 来自古英语。

items.en: The first element traces to Latin aer and Greek aēr, the misty lower atmosphere.
items.cn: 第一个成分可追溯到拉丁语 aer 与希腊语 aēr，指雾气般的下层大气。

items.en: Craft comes from Old English craeft, meaning strength, skill, or a vessel, and it still names skilled work.
items.cn: craft 来自古英语 craeft，意为「力量、技艺、船只」，至今仍指需要技艺的工作。

items.en: The compound aircraft appeared in the age of balloons and early flying machines, before powered flight was common.
items.cn: 复合词 aircraft 出现在气球与早期飞行器的时代，那时动力飞行还不普遍。

items.en: With powered flight the word narrowed toward airplanes and helicopters, and aviation became an industry.
items.cn: 随着动力飞行的发展，这个词收窄到飞机与直升机，航空也成为一门产业。

items.en: Modern compounds such as aircraft carrier and aircraftman extend the word from the machine to the institution around it.
items.cn: aircraft carrier 与 aircraftman 等现代复合词把这个词从机器扩展到围绕它的制度。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers compounds sharing the craft element; the near-meaning group gathers specific kinds of flying machines.
note.cn: 形近组收共享 craft 成分的复合词；近义组收具体的飞行器种类。

entries.definition: A large warship that serves as a floating base for aircraft.
entries.definitionCN: 作为航空器海上基地的大型军舰。

entries.definition: A low-ranking member of an air force, formed from aircraft plus man.
entries.definitionCN: 由 aircraft 加 man 构成，指空军中军衔较低的成员。

entries.definition: A vehicle that rides on a cushion of air, sharing the craft element.
entries.definitionCN: 靠气垫行驶的载具，与 aircraft 共享 craft 这一成分。

entries.definition: A fixed-wing flying vehicle driven by an engine.
entries.definitionCN: 由发动机驱动的固定翼飞行载具。

entries.definition: The British spelling of airplane, used for the same fixed-wing machine.
entries.definitionCN: airplane 的英式拼写，指同一种固定翼飞机。

entries.definition: A flying vehicle lifted and steered by rotating blades.
entries.definitionCN: 靠旋转叶片升空与操控的飞行载具。

normalIntro.en: Aircraft is a transparent compound, and these hooks keep the two halves visible.
normalIntro.cn: aircraft 是个意思透明的复合词；下面这些钩子让两个成分始终清晰可见。

normal.en: Air plus craft: the air is the medium, and the craft is the skilled vessel.
normal.cn: air 加 craft：air 是介质，craft 是需要技艺的载具。

normal.en: Craft also means a boat, so an aircraft is a boat for the air.
normal.cn: craft 也能指船，所以 aircraft 就是一艘在空中航行的船。

normal.en: Aircraft keeps the same form in the plural, like sheep and deer.
normal.cn: aircraft 的复数形式不变，和 sheep、deer 一样。

normal.en: An aircraft carrier is a ship that carries aircraft, which makes the compound easy to unpack.
normal.cn: aircraft carrier 是运载航空器的船，这个复合词因此很容易拆解。

normal.en: Every aircraft begins with the same three letters as the air it flies through.
normal.cn: 每个 aircraft 都以它穿行其间的 air 那三个字母开头。

abstract.en: Aircraft is a name for the human attempt to make the air into a road.
abstract.cn: aircraft 是人类把天空变成道路的尝试所得到的名字。

abstract.en: The word combines a natural element with a human skill, and the machine is the meeting point.
abstract.cn: 这个词把自然元素与人类技艺组合起来，机器就是两者的交会点。

abstract.en: Craft carries the idea of controlled skill, which is why the word suits vehicles that must be piloted.
abstract.cn: craft 带着「受控技艺」的意思，因此这个词适合必须被人操控的载具。

examples.en: The aircraft landed safely despite the storm.
examples.cn: 尽管有暴风雨，这架飞机还是安全着陆了。

examples.en: Rescue aircraft circled the flooded valley.
examples.cn: 救援飞机在洪水淹没的山谷上空盘旋。

examples.en: Modern aircraft can fly through the night.
examples.cn: 现代航空器能够在夜间飞行。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「埃尔克拉夫特」：air 与 craft 连读，就是能飞上天的航空器。

root: 由 air（空气）与 craft（技艺、船只、飞行器）复合而成；craft 源自古英语 cræft（力量、技艺），二十世纪起专指飞行载具。

sensesIntro.en: Aircraft names one flying vehicle, the whole class of flying machines, and a military force made of them.
sensesIntro.cn: aircraft 可指一架飞行载具、整个飞行机器类别，也可指由它们组成的军事力量。

core.en: A crafted vessel that leaves the ground and stays in the air.
core.cn: 一艘经过打造的载具，离开地面并留在空中。

branches.en: One machine that flies, taken as a single object.
branches.cn: 作为单个物体看待的一架飞行机器。

branches.en: The category of all flying machines, spoken of collectively.
branches.cn: 把所有飞行机器作为一个类别来谈。

branches.en: Flying machines organized as a military force.
branches.cn: 被组织成军事力量的飞行机器。

branches.en: Both senses count machines, one by one or as a unit.
branches.cn: 两个义项都在清点机器，或逐架或按单位。

branches.en: Both senses treat aircraft as a body rather than a single craft.
branches.cn: 两个义项都把 aircraft 当作一个整体，而不是单独一架。

intro.en: Aircraft is a compound stem that builds titles, roles, and compound nouns without changing shape.
intro.cn: aircraft 是复合词干，能在不改变形态的情况下构成头衔、角色与复合名词。

latinIntro.en: Only the air half is Latin, from aer; the craft half is Old English and supplies the skilled-vessel idea.
latinIntro.cn: 只有 air 这一半来自拉丁语 aer；craft 这一半来自古英语，提供「技艺载具」的意思。

items.example: The aircraft waited at the gate.
An aircraftman checked the runway lights.
items.exampleCN: 一名航空兵检查了跑道灯。

items.meaning: a female air-force member of low rank
items.example: The aircraftwoman joined the ground crew.
items.exampleCN: 这名女航空兵加入了地勤组。
军用航空器在边境巡逻。

items.example: Civil aircraft share the same airspace.
items.exampleCN: 民用航空器共享同一片空域。

items.meaning: an aircraft without a pilot on board
items.example: The unmanned aircraft mapped the coast.
items.exampleCN: 无人驾驶航空器测绘了海岸线。

items.meaning: an engine built for a flying vehicle
items.example: The aircraft engine was tested on the ground.
items.exampleCN: 航空发动机在地面进行了测试。

latinEntries.example: Aer is the Latin word behind the first half of aircraft.
latinEntries.exampleCN: aer 是 aircraft 前半部分背后的拉丁语词。

definition_zh: 机场；飞机场（尤指小型或军用）；简易起降场
definition_en: an area of level ground with runways where aircraft take off and land, usually smaller than a full airport and often military or temporary
core_image: 一片专门留给飞机起落的场地
scene: 小镇外那块草地战时停过运输机，如今只剩一条旧跑道。The airfield closed to traffic in spring.
sceneCN: 这里 airfield 是「机场」（第 1 个义项：供飞机起降的场地，常指小型或军用）；句意为这座机场在春天停止通航。核心画面是一片专门留给飞机起落的场地。

pos.zh: 机场；飞机场（尤指小型或军用）

derivatives.zh: 同用 air- 的名词，义为「飞行器；飞机」
air 加 strip，义为「简易跑道；小型起降场」
去掉 air- 的部分，义为「场地；田野」

senses.title: Ground where aircraft take off and land
senses.definition: an area of level ground with runways where aircraft take off and land, usually smaller than a full airport and often military
senses.definitionCN: 带有跑道、供飞机起降的平整场地，通常比完整的航空港小，且常为军用
senses.example: The relief flight landed on a muddy airfield.
senses.exampleCN: 救援航班降落在一个泥泞的机场上。
senses.why: Air plus field is literally a field for the air: the word keeps the older sense of field as open ground set aside for one purpose.
senses.whyCN: air 加 field 字面就是「给空中用的场地」：该词保留了 field 的旧义，即为某一用途留出的开阔地面。

senses.title: A wartime or rural landing ground
senses.definition: a temporary or improvised strip used by military or small private aircraft, the sense most common in historical writing
senses.definitionCN: 军用或小型私人飞机使用的临时或简易起降地带，是历史类文本中最常见的用法
senses.example: They built an airfield in six weeks on farmland.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在农田上六周就建成了一座简易机场。
senses.why: Here field keeps its farming meaning: an airfield of this kind really was a farm field with the crops cleared away.
senses.whyCN: 这里 field 保留了农事的含义：这类机场确实就是把庄稼清掉的一块农田。

intro.en: Airfield is a plain English compound: air, the sky, plus field, open ground, naming a field reserved for machines that fly.
intro.cn: airfield 是一个朴素的英语复合词：air「天空」加 field「开阔地面」，指留给飞行机器的一块场地。

items.en: Greek aer meant air or mist, and it is the ultimate source of the English noun air.
items.cn: 希腊语 aer 意为空气或雾气，是英语名词 air 的最终来源。

items.en: Latin borrowed aer unchanged, and Old French air passed it into Middle English after the Norman conquest.
items.cn: 拉丁语原样借入 aer，诺曼征服后古法语 air 把它传入中古英语。

items.en: Old English feld meant open, unenclosed ground, the ancestor of modern field.
items.cn: 古英语 feld 意为开阔、未围起的土地，是现代 field 的祖先。

items.en: English joined air to field during the First World War, when flying grounds were literally marked-out fields.
items.cn: 英语在第一次世界大战期间把 air 与 field 拼合，当时的飞行场地确实就是划出来的田地。

items.en: Today airfield usually suggests a small or military site, while airport names the larger civil hub with terminals.
items.cn: 如今 airfield 多指小型或军用场地，而 airport 指带航站楼的较大民用枢纽。

note.en: The look-alike group keeps the air- compounds; the near-meaning group lists other words for a place where aircraft land.
note.cn: 形近组保留 air- 复合词；近义组列出其他表示「飞机起降场所」的词。

entries.definition: Any machine able to fly in the air.
entries.definitionCN: 任何能在空中飞行的机器。

entries.definition: A narrow strip of ground used as a runway.
entries.definitionCN: 用作跑道的狭长地带。

entries.definition: A company that carries passengers by air.
entries.definitionCN: 用飞机运送旅客的公司。

entries.definition: Far from home or the usual place.
entries.definitionCN: 远离家乡或平常所在之处。

entries.definition: A large site with runways and passenger terminals.
entries.definitionCN: 带跑道与旅客航站楼的大型场所。

entries.definition: A small airport, the older British term.
entries.definitionCN: 小型机场，是较旧的英式说法。

entries.definition: The paved strip aircraft use to take off.
entries.definitionCN: 飞机起飞所用的铺装长条地带。

entries.definition: A small landing area for helicopters.
entries.definitionCN: 供直升机起降的小块场地。

normalIntro.en: Airfield is air plus field: a field kept for the air, that is, for aircraft.
normalIntro.cn: airfield 就是 air 加 field：留给空中使用的场地，也就是留给飞机的场地。

normal.en: Field here means open ground, not a subject of study, so picture grass and a runway.
normal.cn: 这里的 field 指开阔地面，不是学科，所以想象草地和一条跑道。

normal.en: Airfield is smaller and simpler than airport: no terminal, just a strip.
normal.cn: airfield 比 airport 更小更简单：没有航站楼，只有一条跑道。

normal.en: Military writing prefers airfield; travel writing prefers airport.
normal.cn: 军事文本偏爱 airfield，旅行文本偏爱 airport。

normal.en: It is countable, so say two disused airfields, not two airfield.
normal.cn: 它可数，所以说 two disused airfields，不说 two airfield。

normal.en: Do not confuse airfield with afield: one is a place, the other tells how far away.
normal.cn: 别把 airfield 与 afield 混淆：一个是地点，另一个说距离有多远。

abstract.en: Picture a wheat field with the wheat rolled flat into a runway.
abstract.cn: 想象一片麦田，麦子被压平成一条跑道。

abstract.en: Imagine a village whose only landmark is a windsock on a pole.
abstract.cn: 想象一个村庄，唯一的地标是杆子上的风向袋。

abstract.en: Think of a field that swapped its crop for aircraft.
abstract.cn: 想象一块田地，把庄稼换成了飞机。

examples.en: The old airfield is now a business park.
examples.cn: 那座旧机场如今是个商务园区。

examples.en: Fog closed the airfield for most of the morning.
examples.cn: 大雾让机场整个上午大部分时间无法使用。

examples.en: They taxied across the airfield to the hangar.
examples.cn: 他们滑行穿过机场来到机库。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「艾尔菲尔德」——艾尔（air）是天，菲尔德（field）是地：天上来的东西落在地上那块场子，就是机场。

root: air 源自希腊语 aer「空气」，经拉丁语 aer 与古法语 air 进入英语；field 源自古英语 feld「开阔未围之地」。两者在第一次世界大战期间拼合为 airfield，字面即「留给飞行器的场地」。

sensesIntro.en: Both senses are one patch of ground reserved for flying: the general sense covers any such site, and the narrower one recalls the improvised farm strips of wartime.
sensesIntro.cn: 两个义项都是同一块留给飞行的地面：通用义涵盖任何这类场地，较窄的用法则让人想起战时临时开辟的农田跑道。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a field reserved for the air
core.cn: 核心意象：一块留给天空的场地

branches.en: A runway laid on level ground.
branches.cn: 铺在平整地面上的一条跑道。

branches.en: A small site without terminals.
branches.cn: 没有航站楼的小型场地。

branches.en: Farmland cleared for wartime flights.
branches.cn: 为战时飞行清空的农田。

branches.en: A temporary strip that later disappears.
branches.cn: 一条后来又消失的临时跑道。

branches.en: Both keep field as open ground.
branches.cn: 两者都保留 field 的「开阔地面」义。

intro.en: Airfield belongs to the air- compound family, where air names the medium and the second noun names the thing built for it.
intro.cn: airfield 属于 air- 复合词族：air 指媒介，后一个名词指为它建造的东西。

latinIntro.en: Only the air half has a classical source, Greek aer through Latin aer; field is wholly Old English.
latinIntro.cn: 只有 air 这一半有古典来源，即希腊语 aer 经拉丁语 aer；field 完全来自古英语。

latinEntries.example: Aer is the source of air.
latinEntries.exampleCN: aer 是 air 的来源。

latinEntries.example: Aerodromos gives aerodrome.
latinEntries.exampleCN: aerodromos 产生 aerodrome。

definition_zh: 大型客机；班机；（行业用法）客机这一类别
definition_en: a large aircraft built to carry fare-paying passengers on scheduled routes; also the class of such aircraft or the business of operating them
core_image: 一条固定航线上的大班机
scene: 这架宽体机每天往返两地，客座率一直很高。The airliner carries three hundred passengers.
sceneCN: 这里 airliner 是「大型客机」（第 1 个义项：按固定航线载客的大型飞机）；句意为这架客机载客三百人。核心画面是一条固定航线上的大班机。

pos.zh: 大型客机；班机

derivatives.zh: 去掉 -er 的部分，义为「航空公司；航线」
去掉 air- 的部分，义为「班轮；定期客轮」
air 加 lift，义为「空运；空中补给」

senses.title: A large passenger aircraft
senses.definition: a big aircraft built to carry fare-paying passengers on scheduled routes, as opposed to a cargo or private plane
senses.definitionCN: 为在固定航线上运送付费旅客而造的大型飞机，与货机或私人飞机相对
senses.example: The airliner turned back after an engine warning.
senses.exampleCN: 发动机报警后，这架客机返航了。
senses.why: Liner once meant a ship running a fixed line, so airliner simply moves that idea into the sky: a ship of the air on a set route.
senses.whyCN: liner 原指跑固定航线的船，所以 airliner 只是把这个想法搬到天上：一条固定航线上的空中班轮。

senses.title: The class of aircraft as a trade
senses.definition: the class of aircraft or the business of running them, used collectively in industry and news writing
senses.definitionCN: 这一类飞机或经营它们的业务，在行业与新闻文本中作集合用法
senses.example: Airliner orders fell sharply that year.
senses.exampleCN: 那一年客机订单大幅下滑。
senses.why: Here the word stops pointing at one machine and names the whole category, the same shift that happens with aircraft and tonnage.
senses.whyCN: 这里该词不再指一架机器，而是指整个类别，与 aircraft、tonnage 的用法变化相同。

intro.en: Airliner is a sea word lifted into the sky: line gave liner, a ship on a fixed route, and air turned that ship into an aircraft.
intro.cn: airliner 是一个被抬到天上的航海词：line 派生出 liner「跑固定航线的船」，air 再把这条船变成飞机。

items.en: Latin linea meant a linen thread and then a straight line, from linum, flax.
items.cn: 拉丁语 linea 先指亚麻线，后指直线，源自 linum「亚麻」。

items.en: Old French ligne kept the sense of a line or route, and English took it as line.
items.cn: 古法语 ligne 保留「线、路线」之义，英语借作 line。

items.en: By the nineteenth century a liner was a ship sailing a published line of ports, not a wandering trader.
items.cn: 到十九世纪，liner 指按公布航线挂靠港口的大船，而不是四处揽货的散船。

items.en: English added air to line for routes flown on a schedule, first used in the nineteen twenties.
items.cn: 英语把 air 加到 line 上，表示按时刻表飞行的航线，最早用于二十世纪二十年代。

items.en: Adding -er to airline produced airliner, the aircraft that flies the line, modelled directly on the steamship liner.
items.cn: 在 airline 上加 -er 得到 airliner，即飞这条航线的飞机，直接仿照蒸汽班轮 liner 构词。

note.en: The look-alike group keeps the air- and liner compounds; the near-meaning group lists other words for a passenger-carrying plane.
note.cn: 形近组保留 air- 与 liner 复合词；近义组列出其他表示「载客飞机」的词。

entries.definition: A company operating scheduled air services.
entries.definitionCN: 经营定期航空运输的公司。

entries.definition: A large ship sailing a fixed route.
entries.definitionCN: 按固定航线航行的大船。

entries.definition: Ground where aircraft take off and land.
entries.definitionCN: 供飞机起降的场地。

entries.definition: The main performer on a bill.
entries.definitionCN: 演出单上的主角。

entries.definition: A large airliner powered by jet engines.
entries.definitionCN: 由喷气发动机驱动的大型客机。

entries.definition: Any machine capable of flight.
entries.definitionCN: 任何能飞行的机器。

entries.definition: A very large jet, informally a jumbo jet.
entries.definitionCN: 特大型喷气客机，口语称大型珍宝机。

entries.definition: An aircraft, the everyday short form.
entries.definitionCN: 飞机，日常简称。

normalIntro.en: Airliner is airline plus -er: the machine that flies the line of an airline.
normalIntro.cn: airliner 就是 airline 加 -er：飞航空公司那条航线的机器。

normal.en: A liner was first a ship, so an airliner is a ship of the air.
normal.cn: liner 最早是船，所以 airliner 就是空中的船。

normal.en: -er here marks the thing that does the job, as in tanker and freighter.
normal.cn: 这里的 -er 表示干这活的东西，如 tanker、freighter。

normal.en: Airline is the company; airliner is the plane. Never swap them.
normal.cn: airline 是公司，airliner 是飞机，两者绝不能互换。

normal.en: It is countable, so say four wide-body airliners.
normal.cn: 它可数，所以说 four wide-body airliners。

normal.en: Airliners carry passengers; freighters carry cargo.
normal.cn: airliner 载客，freighter 载货。

abstract.en: Picture an ocean liner with wings instead of a hull.
abstract.cn: 想象一艘远洋班轮，船体换成了机翼。

abstract.en: Imagine a bus route drawn across the sky with a timetable.
abstract.cn: 想象一条画在天空中的公交线，还配着时刻表。

abstract.en: Think of a ship that docks at gates instead of ports.
abstract.cn: 想象一艘船，停靠的不是港口而是登机口。

examples.en: The airliner taxied slowly through the rain.
examples.cn: 客机在雨中缓缓滑行。

examples.en: Two airliners were grounded by the storm.
examples.cn: 两架客机因暴风雨停飞。

examples.en: The new airliner burns less fuel per seat.
examples.cn: 这款新客机每个座位的油耗更低。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「艾尔莱纳」——艾尔（air）是天，莱纳（liner）是班轮：天上的班轮，就是大型客机。

root: 拉丁语 linea「亚麻线、直线」经古法语 ligne 进入英语成为 line，加 -er 构成 liner「按固定航线航行的大船」；二十世纪把 air 与 line 拼合成 airline，再加 -er 得到 airliner，字面即「飞固定航线的空中班轮」。

sensesIntro.en: Both senses come from the shipping idea of a fixed line: one names the aircraft that flies it, the other names the whole class of such aircraft.
sensesIntro.cn: 两个义项都来自航运里「固定航线」的想法：一个指飞这条航线的飞机，一个指这一整类飞机。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an ocean liner moved into the sky
core.cn: 核心意象：一艘搬到天上的远洋班轮

branches.en: A wide-body jet on a daily route.
branches.cn: 每天飞固定航线的宽体喷气机。

branches.en: Rows of fare-paying seats.
branches.cn: 一排排付费旅客的座位。

branches.en: Manufacturers counting annual orders.
branches.cn: 制造商统计年度订单。

branches.en: A fleet retired after twenty years.
branches.cn: 一批用了二十年后退役的机队。

branches.en: Both keep the idea of a fixed line.
branches.cn: 两者都保留「固定航线」的想法。

intro.en: Airliner is layered: air names the medium, line names the route, and -er names the vehicle that serves it.
intro.cn: airliner 是分层的：air 指媒介，line 指航线，-er 指跑这条航线的载具。

latinIntro.en: Latin linea, from linum, flax, gave line and liner; the air half and the final -er are English additions.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 linea 源自 linum「亚麻」，产生 line 与 liner；air 这一半与最后的 -er 是英语后加的。

latinEntries.example: Linea comes from linum, flax.
latinEntries.exampleCN: linea 源自 linum「亚麻」。

latinEntries.example: Linum is the plant behind line.
latinEntries.exampleCN: linum 是 line 背后的植物。

definition_zh: 飞机；（乘）飞机这一交通方式
definition_en: a powered flying vehicle with fixed wings, or travel by such a vehicle
core_image: 一架银色的固定翼飞机掠过云层，机翼在光里微微发亮
scene: 机场外的草地上，一个孩子仰头看天，手指跟着那道白线移动。A small airplane climbed slowly above the trees.
sceneCN: 这里 airplane 是「飞机」（第 1 个义项：有固定机翼的动力飞行器）；句意为一架小飞机缓缓爬升到树梢之上。图中可辨识物件：草地、白线、机翼。

pos.zh: 名词：飞机；（乘）飞机

derivatives.zh: 由本词与 mode 合成的名词，义为「飞行模式」
本词的缩略形式，义为「飞机」

senses.title: A fixed-wing flying machine
senses.definition: a powered flying vehicle with fixed wings and an engine, the usual American term
senses.definitionCN: 有固定机翼与发动机的动力飞行器，美式英语的常用说法
senses.example: A small airplane climbed slowly above the trees.
senses.exampleCN: 一架小飞机缓缓爬升到树梢之上。
senses.why: Airplane is a transparent compound of air and plane, where plane is the old word for a flat surface, because the wings are flat.
senses.whyCN: airplane 是 air 与 plane 的透明复合词，而 plane 本指平面，因为机翼是平的。

senses.title: Air travel as a means
senses.definition: in phrases such as by airplane, the means of travelling by air rather than a particular machine
senses.definitionCN: 在 by airplane 这类说法中，指乘飞机这一交通方式，而不是某一架具体的飞机
senses.example: The team travels by airplane when the distance is too long for a bus.
senses.exampleCN: 距离太远、坐大巴不合适时，这支队伍就乘飞机。
senses.why: When the word follows by, it names a mode rather than an object, the same shift that turns bicycle into a way of travelling.
senses.whyCN: 跟在 by 后面时，它命名的是一种方式而非一件物体，这与 bicycle 变成一种出行方式的变化相同。

intro.en: Airplane is an American compound: air plus plane, the old word for a flat surface, named for the flat wings.
intro.cn: airplane 是美式复合词：air 加上 plane，而 plane 本指平面，得名于平坦的机翼。

items.en: Planum meant 'a flat surface', from planus 'flat', the source of plain and plane.
items.cn: planum 意为「平面」，出自 planus「平的」，plain 与 plane 都源于此。

items.en: English plane named a flat surface and a woodworking tool, and later one surface of a wing.
items.cn: 英语 plane 指平面与木工刨，后来也指机翼的一面。

items.en: Early aviation writing used aeroplane in Britain and airplane in America, both built on the flat-wing idea.
items.cn: 早期航空文献在英国用 aeroplane、在美国用 airplane，两者都建立在「平翼」这个想法上。

items.en: Airplane became standard American usage, while aeroplane remained British.
items.cn: airplane 成为美式标准，aeroplane 则留在英式英语中。

items.en: The clipped form plane is now common everywhere, and airplane mode keeps the full word in daily use.
items.cn: 缩略形式 plane 如今各地通用，而 airplane mode 让完整形式仍活跃在日常里。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the plane family and its spelling rivals; the near-meaning group gathers flying machines by type.
note.cn: 形近组收 plane 词族与拼写上的对手；近义组收按类型区分的飞行器。

entries.definition: The British spelling and pronunciation of the same word.
entries.definitionCN: 同一个词的英式拼写与读音。

entries.definition: The short everyday word for an airplane, or a flat surface.
entries.definitionCN: 飞机的日常简称，或指平面。

entries.definition: Simple, ordinary, or a flat stretch of land.
entries.definitionCN: 朴素的、普通的，或指平原。

entries.definition: Any flying machine, including helicopters and balloons.
entries.definitionCN: 任何飞行器，包括直升机与气球。

entries.definition: An aircraft driven by jet engines, usually fast and large.
entries.definitionCN: 由喷气发动机驱动的飞机，通常又快又大。

entries.definition: A plane with no engine that rides rising air.
entries.definitionCN: 没有发动机、借上升气流飞行的飞机。

normalIntro.en: Two real parts carry the word: air and plane, the flat surface of a wing.
normalIntro.cn: 两个真实部件承载这个词：air 与 plane，也就是机翼的平面。

normal.en: Plane is a flat surface, and a wing is flat: airplane is literally a flat thing in the air.
normal.cn: plane 是平面，而机翼是平的：airplane 字面上就是「空中的平面」。

normal.en: Britain keeps aeroplane, America uses airplane; the aero- part points to air as well.
normal.cn: 英国保留 aeroplane，美国用 airplane；aero- 这个成分同样指向空气。

normal.en: Airplane mode switches the radio off, not the plane.
normal.cn: airplane mode 关掉的是无线电，不是飞机。

normal.en: The verb is not used: you do not airplane somewhere, you fly there.
normal.cn: 这个词不作动词：不能说 airplane 到某地，要说 fly。

normal.en: Plane, plain and plane again: only airplane always means the machine.
normal.cn: plane、plain、plane 容易混：只有 airplane 始终指机器。

abstract.en: Naming a machine after a flat surface shows how concrete the roots of technology words usually are.
abstract.cn: 用平面来命名机器，说明技术词根通常多么具体。

abstract.en: Two spellings for one object record two histories of the same invention.
abstract.cn: 同一个物体有两种拼写，记录了同一项发明的两段历史。

abstract.en: By airplane names a way of travelling, which is why it needs no article.
abstract.cn: by airplane 命名的是一种出行方式，所以不需要冠词。

examples.en: A small airplane climbed slowly above the trees.
examples.cn: 一架小飞机缓缓爬升到树梢之上。

examples.en: The team travels by airplane when the distance is too long for a bus.
examples.cn: 距离太远、坐大巴不合适时，这支队伍就乘飞机。

examples.en: He folded the letter into an airplane and threw it across the room.
examples.cn: 他把信折成一架飞机，扔过整个房间。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「爱尔普兰」——爱尔普兰先生把一张纸折成了会飞的平面。

root: 由 air「空气」与 plane「平面」复合而成，因机翼为平面而得名；英式作 aeroplane。

sensesIntro.en: Both senses come from one machine: the object itself, and the way of travelling that the object makes possible.
sensesIntro.cn: 两个义项都出自同一台机器：机器本身，以及这台机器所实现的出行方式。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a silver fixed-wing plane slides through cloud, its wings catching the light.
core.cn: 核心意象：一架银色固定翼飞机穿过云层，机翼在光里发亮。

branches.en: a child pointing at a white trail
branches.cn: 指着白色尾迹的孩子

branches.en: a model with a rubber-band propeller
branches.cn: 装着橡皮筋螺旋桨的模型

branches.en: a ticket bought for a long journey
branches.cn: 为长途出行买的机票

branches.en: a team choosing to fly rather than drive
branches.cn: 选择坐飞机而不是开车的队伍

branches.en: one machine, and the journey it makes possible
branches.cn: 同一台机器，以及它带来的旅程

intro.en: The element air, the Latin-rooted plane, and the compounds and clippings built on them.
intro.cn: 成分 air、源自拉丁语的 plane，以及建在其上的复合词与缩略形式。

latinIntro.en: planum and planus are recorded Latin; the aero- element goes back to Greek aer.
latinIntro.cn: planum 与 planus 都是有文献记录的拉丁词，aero- 成分则可追到希腊语 aēr。

items.meaning: a phone setting that disables radio

definition_zh: 密封的；不透气的；（论点、不在场证明）无懈可击的
definition_en: closed so tightly that no air can enter or escape; figuratively, so carefully constructed that no flaw or objection can get in
core_image: 连一丝空气都挤不进去的封口
scene: 这罐咖啡豆开封后必须拧紧，否则香气几天就散了。An airtight jar keeps the beans fresh.
sceneCN: 这里 airtight 是「密封的」（第 1 个义项：封得极紧、空气进不出）；句意为密封罐能让咖啡豆保持新鲜。核心画面是连一丝空气都挤不进去的封口。

pos.zh: 密封的；不透气的；无懈可击的

collocations.zh: 无懈可击的不在场证明

derivatives.zh: 加 -ly 构成，义为「密封地；严密地」
加 -ness 构成，义为「密封性；严密性」
去掉 air- 的部分，义为「紧的；严密的」

senses.title: Letting no air in or out
senses.definition: closed so tightly that no air can enter or escape, used of containers, seals and rooms
senses.definitionCN: 封得极紧，空气既进不去也出不来，用于容器、封口与房间
senses.example: Store the flour in an airtight container.
senses.exampleCN: 把面粉存放在密封容器里。
senses.why: Air plus tight is literal: the seal is tight against air itself, so nothing gaseous can pass either way.
senses.whyCN: air 加 tight 是字面组合：封口对空气本身都是紧的，所以任何气体双向都过不去。

senses.title: Leaving no gap for doubt
senses.titleCN: 无懈可击的；滴水不漏的
senses.definition: so carefully constructed that no flaw or objection can get in, used of arguments, alibis and security
senses.definitionCN: 构造得极其严密，任何漏洞或反驳都钻不进来，用于论点、不在场证明与安保
senses.example: Her alibi was airtight, so the police let her go.
senses.exampleCN: 她的不在场证明无懈可击，警方于是放了她。
senses.why: The same seal is imagined around a claim: if no air gets in, no doubt gets in either, and the argument holds.
senses.whyCN: 同一道封口被想象在某个说法周围：空气进不来，怀疑也进不来，论点就站得住。

intro.en: Airtight is a transparent English compound: air plus tight, first of physical seals and later of anything that admits no gap.
intro.cn: airtight 是一个透明的英语复合词：air 加 tight，先指实物封口，后来指任何不留缝隙的东西。

items.en: Greek aer meant air, and it reached English as air through Latin and Old French.
items.cn: 希腊语 aer 意为空气，经拉丁语与古法语进入英语成为 air。

items.en: Old Norse thettr meant close or watertight, and Middle English took it as thight, later tight.
items.cn: 古挪威语 thettr 意为紧密、不透水，中古英语借作 thight，后来成为 tight。

items.en: By the fifteenth century tight meant firmly fixed or leaving no gap, used of knots and seals.
items.cn: 到十五世纪，tight 意为固定得牢或不留缝隙，用于绳结与封口。

items.en: English joined air to tight in the seventeenth century, first written with a hyphen, of vessels that held air.
items.cn: 英语在十七世纪把 air 与 tight 拼合，最初带连字符，指能保住空气的容器。

items.en: The hyphen dropped and the word gained a figurative sense in the nineteenth century, of alibis and reasoning.
items.cn: 连字符脱落，该词在十九世纪获得比喻义，用于不在场证明与推理。

note.en: The look-alike group keeps the -tight compounds; the near-meaning group lists other words for sealed or flawless.
note.cn: 形近组保留 -tight 复合词；近义组列出其他表示「密封」或「无漏洞」的词。

entries.definition: Letting no water through; leaving no doubt.
entries.definitionCN: 不透水的；无懈可击的。

entries.definition: Firmly fixed, leaving little space.
entries.definitionCN: 固定得牢，几乎不留空隙。

entries.definition: The quality of being sealed against air.
entries.definitionCN: 对空气密封的性质。

entries.definition: Anxious and unable to relax.
entries.definitionCN: 焦虑而无法放松的。

entries.definition: Closed so that nothing can pass in or out.
entries.definitionCN: 封住使任何东西都进不出。

entries.definition: Completely sealed, especially against air.
entries.definitionCN: 完全密封的，尤指对空气。

entries.definition: Without any defect or mistake.
entries.definitionCN: 没有任何缺陷或错误。

entries.definition: Impossible to attack or dispute.
entries.definitionCN: 无法攻击或反驳的。

normalIntro.en: Airtight is air plus tight: tight against air, and by extension tight against doubt.
normalIntro.cn: airtight 就是 air 加 tight：对空气是紧的，引申为对怀疑也是紧的。

normal.en: Watertight and airtight are built the same way: name what must not get through.
normal.cn: watertight 与 airtight 构词方式相同：说出不能让什么东西通过。

normal.en: An airtight alibi lets no doubt in, just as an airtight jar lets no air in.
normal.cn: 无懈可击的不在场证明不让怀疑进来，正如密封罐不让空气进来。

normal.en: It is usually placed before a noun: an airtight case, an airtight seal.
normal.cn: 它通常放在名词前：an airtight case、an airtight seal。

normal.en: The older spelling air-tight means exactly the same thing.
normal.cn: 较早的拼写 air-tight 意思完全相同。

normal.en: Do not say very airtight in formal writing; prefer completely airtight.
normal.cn: 正式写作中不说 very airtight，宜用 completely airtight。

abstract.en: Picture a jar whose lid has no seam at all.
abstract.cn: 想象一只罐子，盖子上完全没有接缝。

abstract.en: Imagine an argument wrapped in glass so no objection can reach it.
abstract.cn: 想象一个论点被玻璃包住，任何反驳都碰不到它。

abstract.en: Think of a story with every hole already plugged.
abstract.cn: 想象一个故事，每个漏洞都已被堵上。

examples.en: The lid forms an airtight seal when you press it down.
examples.cn: 按下盖子时会形成密封。

examples.en: Prosecutors need an airtight case before going to trial.
examples.cn: 检方在开庭前需要一个无懈可击的案子。

examples.en: Keep the vaccine in airtight packaging.
examples.cn: 把疫苗保存在密封包装中。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「艾尔太特」——艾尔（air）是气，太特（tight）是紧：气都挤不进去，就是密封的、无懈可击的。

root: air 源自希腊语 aer「空气」，tight 源自古挪威语 thettr「紧密、不透水」经中古英语 thight 演变而来；十七世纪两者拼合为 air-tight，指不透气，十九世纪引申为「无懈可击」。

sensesIntro.en: One seal is described twice: physically it stops air, figuratively it stops doubt, and in both cases the point is that nothing unwanted gets through.
sensesIntro.cn: 同一道封口被描述了两次：实物层面挡住空气，比喻层面挡住怀疑，两者的要点都是「不让任何不想要的东西通过」。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a seal that lets nothing through
core.cn: 核心意象：一道什么都不让过的封口

branches.en: A jar lid with no gap.
branches.cn: 没有缝隙的罐盖。

branches.en: A room sealed against fumes.
branches.cn: 封住不让烟气进入的房间。

branches.en: An alibi with every minute accounted for.
branches.cn: 每分钟都有交代的不在场证明。

branches.en: A contract with no loophole.
branches.cn: 没有漏洞的合同。

branches.en: Both refuse any unwanted entry.
branches.cn: 两者都拒绝任何不想要的进入。

intro.en: Airtight belongs to the -tight family, where the first element names what must be kept out and tight supplies the idea of a firm seal.
intro.cn: airtight 属于 -tight 词族：前一个成分说明要挡住什么，tight 提供「封得紧」的想法。

latinIntro.en: Only air has a classical source, Greek aer through Latin aer; tight came from Old Norse, so the Latin layer is thin.
latinIntro.cn: 只有 air 有古典来源，即希腊语 aer 经拉丁语 aer；tight 来自古挪威语，所以拉丁语层次很薄。

latinEntries.example: Aer gives English air.
latinEntries.exampleCN: aer 产生英语 air。

definition_zh: 警报器；闹钟；警报；惊恐；使惊慌
definition_en: a device or signal that warns of danger, sudden fear, or to make someone frightened
core_image: 深夜走廊里一只红色蜂鸣器突然亮起，光在墙上抖
scene: 凌晨三点，走廊里的蜂鸣器突然响起来，所有人都被惊醒。The fire alarm woke everyone in the building.
sceneCN: 这里 alarm 是「警报器」（第 1 个义项：发出声响以警告危险的装置）；句意为火警警报器把楼里所有人都吵醒了。图中可辨识物件：蜂鸣器、走廊、应急灯。

pos.zh: 名词：警报器；闹钟；警报；惊恐
动词：使惊慌；使担忧

derivatives.zh: 由本词加形容词后缀构成，义为「令人惊慌的」
由形容词加副词后缀构成，义为「惊人地；令人担忧地」
由本词加表人后缀构成，义为「危言耸听者」
由过去分词转化而来，义为「惊慌的；担忧的」

senses.title: A warning device
senses.definition: a device that makes a loud noise to warn people of danger or to wake them
senses.definitionCN: 发出巨响以警告危险或唤醒人的装置
senses.example: The fire alarm woke everyone in the building.
senses.exampleCN: 火警警报器把楼里所有人都吵醒了。
senses.why: The word began as a shout, and the device inherited the shout: what once called people to arms now calls them out of bed.
senses.whyCN: 这个词原本是一声喊叫，装置继承了那声喊叫：从前喊人拿起武器，如今喊人起床。

senses.title: A warning signal
senses.definition: a sound or message that warns people of approaching danger
senses.definitionCN: 提醒人们危险临近的声音或讯息
senses.example: The sirens sounded an air-raid alarm across the city.
senses.exampleCN: 警报声在全城拉响了空袭警报。
senses.why: This sense keeps the message rather than the machine: the alarm is the warning itself, whether or not a device produces it.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项保留的是讯息而非机器：alarm 就是警告本身，不管是不是由装置发出。

senses.title: Sudden fear
senses.definition: sudden fear caused by the awareness of danger
senses.definitionCN: 意识到危险时突然产生的恐惧
senses.example: She looked up in alarm when the door slammed.
senses.exampleCN: 门砰地关上时，她惊慌地抬起头。
senses.why: Before there were sirens, alarm named the feeling a sudden cry produced in the chest, and that older sense survives in in alarm.
senses.whyCN: 在警报器出现之前，alarm 指的是突然的喊声在胸口引起的那种感觉，这个旧义仍保存在 in alarm 里。

senses.title: To make someone anxious
senses.definition: to make someone feel worried or frightened
senses.definitionCN: 使某人感到担忧或害怕
senses.example: The drop in sales alarmed the board.
senses.exampleCN: 销量下滑让董事会感到不安。
senses.why: The verb reverses the direction: instead of feeling the cry, you become the thing that sets it off in others.
senses.whyCN: 动词把方向反过来：不再是听见喊声的人，而是让别人心里响起喊声的那一方。

intro.en: Alarm began as an Italian shout meaning 'to arms', and it still carries that urgency inside it.
intro.cn: alarm 最初是一句意大利语的呼喊，意为「拿起武器」，至今仍带着那股紧迫感。

items.en: The cry all'arme meant 'to arms!', what a watchman shouted when enemies approached.
items.cn: all'arme 意为「拿起武器！」，是守夜人发现敌人逼近时的呼喊。

items.en: French took the cry as alarme, naming both the shout and the fear it caused.
items.cn: 法语把这声呼喊借作 alarme，既指喊声，也指它引起的恐惧。

items.en: English borrowed it in the fourteenth century, first as a call to arms and then as any warning.
items.cn: 英语在十四世纪借入，先指「召人御敌的号令」，后泛指任何警告。

items.en: The word spread to bells, drums and clocks, and the mechanical alarm clock appears in the seventeenth century.
items.cn: 这个词扩展到钟、鼓与时钟，机械闹钟在十七世纪出现。

items.en: The emotional sense survives mainly in in alarm and take alarm, while the device sense dominates everyday use.
items.cn: 情绪义主要保存在 in alarm 与 take alarm 中，装置义则在日常使用中占主导。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words built on alarm; the near-meaning group gathers warnings and sudden fears.
note.cn: 形近组收由 alarm 构成的词；近义组收警告与突发恐惧类词。

entries.definition: Causing worry or fear, often said of a trend.
entries.definitionCN: 引起担忧或恐惧的，常形容某种趋势。

entries.definition: A person who spreads exaggerated warnings of danger.
entries.definitionCN: 散布夸大危险警告的人。

entries.definition: Frightened or worried by something.
entries.definitionCN: 被某事惊到或担忧的。

entries.definition: Words or a sign that tell people about possible danger.
entries.definitionCN: 告知可能危险的话语或标志。

entries.definition: A loud device that makes a long wailing sound as a warning.
entries.definitionCN: 发出长鸣作为警告的响亮装置。

entries.definition: Sudden uncontrolled fear that spreads through a group.
entries.definitionCN: 在人群中蔓延的突然失控的恐惧。

normalIntro.en: Two real parts carry the word: the Italian cry all'arme and its French reshaping.
normalIntro.cn: 两个真实部件承载这个词：意大利语呼喊 all'arme 及其法语改写形式。

normal.en: Alarm was once a shout: all'arme means 'to arms', so the word still sounds urgent.
normal.cn: alarm 原本是一声喊：all'arme 意为「拿起武器」，所以这个词至今听起来紧急。

normal.en: The device and the feeling share one word because a cry produces both.
normal.cn: 装置与情绪共用一个词，因为一声呼喊同时产生两者。

normal.en: An alarm clock is a shout that comes from a small box.
normal.cn: 闹钟就是从一个小盒子里发出的那声大喊。

normal.en: In alarm keeps the old emotional sense; set the alarm uses the new device sense.
normal.cn: in alarm 保留古老的情绪义；set the alarm 用的是装置义。

normal.en: One l, then a: a-l-a-r-m, not allarm.
normal.cn: 一个 l 后接 a：a-l-a-r-m，不是 allarm。

abstract.en: A word born as a battle cry now wakes people for work, which is a small history of peace.
abstract.cn: 一个诞生于战场的词如今唤人上班，这本身就是一小段和平史。

abstract.en: Alarm is designed to interrupt: its whole purpose is to break whatever you were doing.
abstract.cn: 警报的设计目的就是打断：它存在的意义就是中止你正在做的事。

abstract.en: A false alarm is a reminder that the feeling and the fact can come apart.
abstract.cn: 虚惊一场提醒我们：感受与事实可以彼此脱节。

examples.en: The fire alarm woke everyone in the building.
examples.cn: 火警警报器把楼里所有人都吵醒了。

examples.en: She looked up in alarm when the door slammed.
examples.cn: 门砰地关上时，她惊慌地抬起头。

examples.en: The drop in sales alarmed the board.
examples.cn: 销量下滑让董事会感到不安。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「额，拉姆」——额，拉姆一按按钮，整栋楼都响起了警报。

root: 源自意大利语呼喊 all'arme「拿起武器」，经法语 alarme 进入英语，由「召人御敌的号令」引申为警报器、警报与惊恐。

sensesIntro.en: One cry runs through all four senses: the device that makes it, the message it carries, the fear it plants, and the act of setting it off in others.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项贯穿着同一声呼喊：发出呼喊的装置、呼喊携带的讯息、呼喊种下的恐惧，以及让别人心里响起呼喊的动作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a red buzzer lights up in a dark corridor and the light shakes on the wall.
core.cn: 核心意象：深夜走廊里一只红色蜂鸣器亮起，光在墙上抖动。

branches.en: a clock ringing at half past six
branches.cn: 六点半响起的闹钟

branches.en: a siren rising over the rooftops
branches.cn: 越过屋顶的警报声

branches.en: a face turned suddenly towards a noise
branches.cn: 被响声惊得猛然转过去的脸

branches.en: a chart that makes a board sit up
branches.cn: 让董事会坐直身子的那张图表

branches.en: one cry, heard as an object and felt as a state
branches.cn: 同一声呼喊，既被当作器物，也被感受为状态

intro.en: An Italian phrase, its French reshaping, and the English endings built on the borrowed noun.
intro.cn: 一个意大利短语、它的法语改写，以及建在这个借词上的英语词尾。

latinIntro.en: The phrase is Italian, not Latin, though arme goes back to Latin arma, 'weapons', so the Latin list has one entry.
latinIntro.cn: 这个短语属意大利语而非拉丁语，但 arme 可追到拉丁语 arma「武器」，因此拉丁词条只列一个。

definition_zh: 虽然；尽管
definition_en: although, used to introduce a phrase that admits something while qualifying the main statement
core_image: 一句话说完，又回头补上一句「虽然如此」，把话说得更稳
scene: 方案被改得只剩三页，讨论却还没开始。The plan was accepted, albeit with several conditions.
sceneCN: 这里 albeit 是「虽然、尽管」（第 1 个义项：引导让步短语，表示前面的话要打个折扣）；句意为方案被接受了，尽管附有几个条件。图中可辨识物件：三页方案、长桌、批注笔。

pos.zh: 连词：虽然；尽管

derivatives.zh: albeit 的原始三词形式，义为「尽管它是……」
同一构词模式的古旧连词，义为「虽然；然而」

senses.title: Although, before a phrase
senses.definition: although, used chiefly before an adjective, adverb, or prepositional phrase to concede a point
senses.definitionCN: 意为「虽然」，多用于形容词、副词或介词短语之前，表示让步
senses.example: The plan was accepted, albeit with several conditions.
senses.exampleCN: 方案被接受了，尽管附有几个条件。
senses.why: Albeit is a compressed clause, 'all be it', so it can carry only a small phrase: what follows is the thing that 'is' conceded.
senses.whyCN: albeit 是一个压缩的从句「all be it」，所以只能带一个小短语：后面跟的就是被承认「是」的那一点。

senses.title: Although, before a full clause, in older use
senses.titleCN: 虽然（后接完整从句的古旧用法）
senses.definition: in older writing, although, used before a full clause with its own subject and verb
senses.definitionCN: 在较旧的文字中意为「虽然」，后面可以接带主语和动词的完整从句
senses.example: Albeit he was tired, he stayed until the end.
senses.exampleCN: 尽管他很累，还是留到了最后。
senses.why: Because the word still contains 'it', older writers could let a whole clause follow; modern usage prefers although for that job.
senses.whyCN: 由于这个词里仍含有 it，旧时作者可以接一整个从句；现代用法则把这个任务交给 although。

intro.en: Albeit is a whole clause worn down into one word: 'all be it' became a single concessive conjunction.
intro.cn: albeit 是一整个从句磨损成一个词：「all be it」变成了单一的让步连词。

items.en: The phrase all be it meant 'though it be all (that)', a concessive clause used after a statement.
items.cn: 短语 all be it 意为「尽管它是这样」，是放在陈述之后的让步从句。

items.en: Reduced forms such as al be it appear in the fourteenth century, with al as a variant of all.
items.cn: 十四世纪出现 al be it 这类缩减形式，其中 al 是 all 的变体。

items.en: The three words fuse into albeit, and the new word is felt as a single conjunction.
items.cn: 三个词融合成 albeit，新词被当作一个整体连词来使用。

items.en: Albeit is common in formal prose, often introducing a short phrase rather than a clause.
items.cn: albeit 在正式散文中常见，多引导短短语而不是完整从句。

items.en: The word survives mainly in careful writing, where its brevity is valued over the plainer although.
items.cn: 这个词主要活在讲究的文字里，人们看重它比 although 更简洁。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words built on the same 'be it' pattern; the near-meaning group gathers concessive connectors.
note.cn: 形近组收同一「be it」模式构成的词；近义组收表示让步的连接词。

entries.definition: An archaic conjunction meaning although or nevertheless.
entries.definitionCN: 古旧连词，意为「虽然」或「然而」。

entries.definition: An archaic conjunction meaning provided that.
entries.definitionCN: 古旧连词，意为「只要；倘若」。

entries.definition: The standard conjunction for conceding a fact before the main clause.
entries.definitionCN: 在主句前承认某一事实的标准连词。

entries.definition: A shorter and more informal form of although, also usable at the end of a sentence.
entries.definitionCN: although 更短更口语的形式，也可放在句末。

entries.definition: Used to contrast two facts, more neutral than a concession.
entries.definitionCN: 用于对比两项事实，比让步更中性。

normalIntro.en: Three real words carry it: all, be, and it, worn down into one conjunction.
normalIntro.cn: 三个真实词承载它：all、be、it，磨损成一个连词。

normal.en: Albeit is all be it: say the three words fast and the conjunction appears.
normal.cn: albeit 就是 all be it：把三个词连快说，连词就出来了。

normal.en: Because it contains be, it likes short phrases rather than full clauses.
normal.cn: 因为里面含有 be，它更爱接短短语而不是完整从句。

normal.en: Albeit is one word, never two: no comma inside it.
normal.cn: albeit 是一个词，不是两个：中间不加逗号。

normal.en: Use albeit for a concession you want to keep brief; use although when a clause follows.
normal.cn: 想简短地让一步就用 albeit；后面跟完整从句时用 although。

normal.en: The stress falls at the end: al-BE-it.
normal.cn: 重音落在末尾：al-BE-it。

abstract.en: A three-word clause collapsed into one word shows how grammar compresses repeated thought.
abstract.cn: 三个词的从句缩成一个词，说明语法会压缩反复出现的想法。

abstract.en: Albeit admits a limitation without withdrawing the claim, which is a very precise social move.
abstract.cn: albeit 承认一个限制，却不撤回主张，这是一种非常精确的社交动作。

abstract.en: The word now sounds formal because plain although does the same work more cheaply.
abstract.cn: 这个词如今显得正式，因为朴素的 although 用更低的成本完成了同样的事。

examples.en: The plan was accepted, albeit with several conditions.
examples.cn: 方案被接受了，尽管附有几个条件。

examples.en: He agreed to help, albeit reluctantly.
examples.cn: 他同意帮忙，尽管很不情愿。

examples.en: The team won the match, albeit by a single point.
examples.cn: 球队赢了比赛，尽管只赢了一分。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「噢，必特」——噢，必特先生答应了，虽然有点勉强。

root: 源自中古英语短语 all be it「尽管它是」，三个词融合为一个让步连词。

sensesIntro.en: Both senses concede a point; the only difference is how much grammar the word is allowed to carry after it.
sensesIntro.cn: 两个义项都在让一步，区别只在于这个词后面能带多少语法成分。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a sentence finishes, then a hand goes back to add 'even so' at the edge.
core.cn: 核心意象：一句话说完，一只手又回去在边上补一句「即便如此」。

branches.en: a yes followed by a list of conditions
branches.cn: 一个「同意」后面跟着一串条件

branches.en: a slow yes, said with a sigh
branches.cn: 叹着气说出的那个「好」

branches.en: an old sentence with a full clause after it
branches.cn: 后面接着完整从句的旧式句子

branches.en: a page of seventeenth-century prose
branches.cn: 十七世纪散文的一页

branches.en: one concession, now short and now long
branches.cn: 同一个让步，有时短，有时长

intro.en: Three ordinary English words fused into a single conjunction.
intro.cn: 三个普通英语单词融合成一个连词。

latinIntro.en: Every part is native English; there is no Latin layer, so the Latin list is empty.
latinIntro.cn: 每个成分都是英语本族词，没有拉丁语层，因此拉丁词条列表为空。

definition_zh: 音乐专辑；相册；集邮册；签名纪念册；（古罗马）白色公告板
definition_en: a collection of recorded songs issued together, a book for keeping photographs, stamps or signatures, or the whitened board on which public notices were written in ancient Rome
core_image: 一本硬壳大书摊在膝上，纸页里贴着一排排小方片
scene: 客厅的矮柜里躺着一本硬壳大书，翻开是婚礼那天的照片，边角已经微微发黄。She opened the album and found a photograph of her grandmother at twenty.
sceneCN: 这里 album 是「相册」（第 2 个义项：收集照片的册子）；句意为她翻开相册，找到一张祖母二十岁时的照片。画面里是矮柜、硬壳书与泛黄的照片。

pos.zh: 名词：音乐专辑；相册；集邮册；签名纪念册；古罗马公告板

derivatives.zh: 由前缀 mini- 与 album 组合而成，义为「迷你专辑」，指曲目较少、时长较短的发行形式
由 album 与 -oriented 组合而成，义为「以专辑为导向的」，多用于描述电台的编排格式

senses.title: A collection of recorded songs
senses.titleCN: 音乐专辑：成套发行的录音作品
senses.definition: a set of recorded songs or pieces released together as one work, on disc, tape or in digital form
senses.definitionCN: 作为一件作品成套发行的录音歌曲或乐曲，载体可以是唱片、磁带或数字文件
senses.example: Their second album sold a million copies in a month.
senses.exampleCN: 他们的第二张专辑一个月内卖出一百万张。
senses.why: Early records were sold in a book-like sleeve holding several discs, so the container's name moved onto the collection of songs inside it.
senses.whyCN: 早期的唱片装在一个像书一样、能装几张唱片的封套里，于是容器的名字转移到了里面那一组歌曲上。

senses.title: A book of photographs
senses.definition: a book with blank pages or pockets in which photographs are kept
senses.definitionCN: 有空白页或插袋、用来存放照片的册子
senses.example: The wedding album sat on the shelf for years without being opened.
senses.exampleCN: 那本婚礼相册在书架上放了好几年都没被翻开。
senses.why: Album first meant a blank surface for writing, and photographs are simply what people began pasting onto that blank surface.
senses.whyCN: album 最初指可供书写的空白表面，而照片不过是人们后来贴到这个空白表面上的东西。

senses.title: A book for stamps and clippings
senses.titleCN: 集邮册：贴存邮票与剪报的册子
senses.definition: a book with pages for mounting stamps, postcards, newspaper cuttings or other small flat items
senses.definitionCN: 页面可固定邮票、明信片、剪报或其他小件平面收藏品的册子
senses.example: He pasted every foreign stamp into a green album.
senses.exampleCN: 他把每一枚外国邮票都贴进一本绿色集邮册。
senses.why: The same blank book serves any small flat treasure, so stamps and clippings simply repeat the collecting gesture that photographs had already taught.
senses.whyCN: 同一本空白册子可以服务任何小件平面收藏品，于是邮票与剪报只是重复照片已经教会人们的那个「收集」动作。

senses.title: A book of signatures and memories
senses.titleCN: 签名纪念册：留字留念的册子
senses.definition: a book in which friends, guests or classmates write their names, wishes or short messages as a keepsake
senses.definitionCN: 请朋友、来客或同学写下姓名、祝愿或短句以作留念的册子
senses.example: Her classmates filled an album with wishes before she moved away.
senses.exampleCN: 她搬走之前，同学们在一本纪念册里写满了祝福。
senses.why: This is the oldest modern use: a blank book passed from hand to hand, so that the writing itself becomes the collection.
senses.whyCN: 这是这本书最早的现代用法：一本空白册子在人们手中传递，写下的字本身就成了被收藏的内容。

senses.title: The whitened notice board of Rome
senses.titleCN: 古罗马白色公告板：张贴公告的涂白木板
senses.definition: in ancient Rome, a board whitened with gypsum on which public notices, lists and announcements were written
senses.definitionCN: 古罗马用石膏涂白的木板，上面书写公告、名单与通告
senses.example: In Rome a notice of the games was painted on an album in the forum.
senses.exampleCN: 在罗马，竞技公告被写在广场的一块白色公告板上。
senses.why: The Latin word named a whitened board before it named a book, and this is the literal image from which every later collection sense grows.
senses.whyCN: 这个拉丁词先指涂白的木板，后指册子；正是这块板子的具体形象，长出了后来所有的「收集」义。

intro.en: Album comes straight from Latin, where it began as a whitened board and ended as a blank book.
intro.cn: album 直接来自拉丁语，在那里它先是一块涂白的木板，后来才成为空白册子。

items.en: Albus was the adjective for white or pale; it is the colour word behind the whole family, including albedo and albino.
items.cn: albus 是表示「白色、苍白」的形容词，是 albedo、albino 等一整族词背后的颜色词。

items.en: The neuter noun album meant a white tablet or board, especially one whitened with gypsum for public notices and lists.
items.cn: 中性名词 album 指白色的板或牌，尤指用石膏涂白、供书写公告与名单的木板。

items.en: Medieval Latin extended album from the board to the written list itself, and then to a blank book or register kept for entries.
items.cn: 中世纪拉丁语把 album 从木板扩展到写在上面的名单，再扩展到供人题写的空白册子或登记簿。

items.en: English album is recorded in the seventeenth century for a blank book in which friends wrote names and verses; the exact first date is uncertain.
items.cn: 英语 album 在十七世纪有记录，指供朋友写下姓名与赠言的空白册子；确切首见年代不确定。

items.en: Photograph and stamp albums belong to the nineteenth century; the recorded-music album grew out of book-like record sleeves in the twentieth century.
items.cn: 照片相册与集邮册属于十九世纪；唱片专辑则从二十世纪那种像书一样的唱片封套中发展出来。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words from the same Latin colour root albus; the near-meaning group gathers other kinds of collected works and books.
note.cn: 形近组收同一拉丁颜色词根 albus 的一族词；近义组收其他类型的作品合集与册子。

entries.definition: The proportion of light a surface reflects; a scientific word built on Latin albus, white.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「反照率、反射率」，指表面反射光的比例；由拉丁语 albus「白」构成。

entries.definition: A person or animal born with no pigment in skin, hair or eyes; formed from the same white root.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「白化病患者、白化动物」，指出生时皮肤、毛发或眼睛缺少色素者；同出「白」这一词根。

entries.definition: The white of an egg; the Latin noun albumen also meant egg white, from albus.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「蛋白、蛋清」；拉丁语 albumen 本也指蛋清，源自 albus。

entries.definition: A white linen robe worn by priests; a church word from the Latin adjective for white.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「白麻布长袍」，是神职人员穿的礼服；来自拉丁语表示白色的形容词。

entries.definition: A collection of pieces gathered from various sources into one work.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「合集、汇编」，指从不同来源收集作品编成一册或一张。

entries.definition: A book of blank pages for pasting in photographs, cuttings and small keepsakes.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「剪贴簿」，指空白页可粘贴照片、剪报与小纪念品的册子。

entries.definition: A published collection of poems or stories by different writers.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「选集、诗文集」，指把不同作者的诗或小说编在一起出版的书。

entries.definition: A flat case, or the set of works it holds, used to show an artist's or designer's output.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「作品集、画夹」，指装作品的扁平夹子或其中展示艺术家成果的一组作品。

entries.definition: A disc carrying recorded sound; the physical object an album is played from.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「唱片」，指承载录音的圆盘，即播放专辑所用的实物。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real Latin root albus, the board-to-book history, and the phrases album appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子使用真实的拉丁词根 albus、从木板到册子的词义史，以及 album 实际出现的搭配。

normal.en: Albus means white: the first album was a board whitened with gypsum so that notices would stand out.
normal.cn: albus 意为白色：最早的 album 是一块用石膏涂白的木板，好让公告更醒目。

normal.en: The word moved from board to list to blank book, which is why a photo album and a stamp album feel like the same object.
normal.cn: 这个词从木板走到名单，再走到空白册子，所以相册与集邮册感觉是同一种东西。

normal.en: Albedo, albino and albumen all keep the white idea, though their meanings moved far from paper.
normal.cn: albedo、albino、albumen 都保留了「白」的观念，尽管词义已经远离纸张。

normal.en: A studio album is recorded in a studio; a debut album is the first one a band releases.
normal.cn: studio album 是在录音室录的专辑；debut album 是乐队发行的第一张。

normal.en: The album cover is the book cover of this modern book of songs.
normal.cn: album cover 就是这本现代「歌本」的封面。

abstract.en: Picture a white board in a Roman square, then the same white surface bound into pages.
abstract.cn: 想象罗马广场上的一块白板，再想象同一片白色被装订成页。

abstract.en: The pages can hold photographs, stamps, signatures or songs; the container stays, the contents change.
abstract.cn: 这些页面可以装照片、邮票、签名或歌曲；容器不变，内容不断更换。

abstract.en: An album is an argument that separate small things belong together.
abstract.cn: album 本身就是一个主张：一件件小东西应当被放在一起。

examples.en: Their second album sold a million copies.
examples.cn: 他们的第二张专辑卖出了一百万张。

examples.en: She keeps every holiday photo in a thick album.
examples.cn: 她把每张假日照片都收在一本厚相册里。

examples.en: The band is recording a new album in London.
examples.cn: 乐队正在伦敦录制一张新专辑。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿尔本」——阿尔白白的，本子也白白的：先贴公告，再贴照片与歌。

root: album 直接借自拉丁语 album，本义是「涂白的板」，来自形容词 albus「白色」。古罗马人把公告写在涂了石膏的白板上，中世纪拉丁语再由「白板上的名单」引申为空白登记册，英语十七世纪用它指题字留念的册子，十九世纪起指相册与集邮册，二十世纪又指唱片专辑。

sensesIntro.en: All five senses are the same blank surface: a whitened board for notices, then a blank book for signatures, photographs, stamps, and finally a sleeve for songs.
sensesIntro.cn: 五个义项都是同一片空白表面：先是贴公告的白板，再是题字、贴照片、贴邮票的空白册子，最后是装歌曲的封套。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a white board waits for writing, and later the same white surface is bound into pages.
core.cn: 核心意象：一块白板等着被书写，后来同一片白色被装订成了书页。

branches.en: THE SONGS: a book-like sleeve holds discs, and its name passes to the songs inside.
branches.cn: 歌曲线：像书一样的封套装着唱片，名字便转到了里面的歌曲上。

branches.en: THE PHOTOGRAPHS: the blank page becomes a place to keep images.
branches.cn: 照片线：空白页面成了保存影像的地方。

branches.en: THE STAMPS: any small flat treasure can be pasted onto the same page.
branches.cn: 邮票线：任何小件平面收藏品都能贴到同样的页面上。

branches.en: THE SIGNATURES: friends write on the blank page, and the writing itself is the collection.
branches.cn: 签名线：朋友在空白页上写字，写下的字本身就是收藏。

branches.en: THE BOARD: the Roman notice board is the literal white surface behind every later sense.
branches.cn: 木板线：古罗马的公告板是后来所有义项背后那片具体的白色表面。

intro.en: Album is a Latin noun with a Latin adjective inside it; English adds combining forms and suffixes to build new words around it.
intro.cn: album 是一个内含拉丁形容词的拉丁名词；英语再用组合形式与后缀在它周围造新词。

latinIntro.en: Albus, album, albumen and albedo are all recorded Latin forms, so nothing in this family needs to be reconstructed.
latinIntro.cn: albus、album、albumen 与 albedo 都是有记录的拉丁语形式，这一族词无需重构。

items.example: Albus is the colour word inside album.
items.exampleCN: albus 是 album 里面的那个颜色词。

items.example: The root appears in albino and albedo.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根出现在 albino 与 albedo 里。

items.example: The Latin noun is the direct source of the English word.
items.exampleCN: 这个拉丁名词是英语词的直接来源。

items.example: It marks the gender of Latin album.
items.exampleCN: 它标出拉丁语 album 的性。

items.meaningCN: 构成 albumen 这类名词的词尾

latinEntries.meaning: a white board for notices; a register

derivatives.zh: 由前缀 mini- 与 album 组合而成，义为「迷你专辑」
由 album 与 -oriented 组合而成，义为「以专辑为导向的」

definition_zh: 炼金术士；（比喻）点石成金的人
definition_en: a person who practised alchemy, trying to turn base metals into gold; figuratively, someone who turns ordinary material into something valuable
core_image: 守着炉子想把铅变成金的那个人
scene: 他守着一炉黑灰熬了半辈子，只想把铅变成金子。The alchemist kept his furnace burning all night.
sceneCN: 这里 alchemist 是「炼金术士」（第 1 个义项：试图把贱金属变成黄金的古代化学实践者）；句意为这位炼金术士让炉子整夜烧着。核心画面是守着炉子想把铅变成金的那个人。

pos.zh: 炼金术士；点石成金的人

derivatives.zh: 去掉 -ist 的学科名，义为「炼金术」
加 -ical 构成，义为「炼金术的」
加 -ize 构成，义为「使嬗变；点化」

senses.title: One who practised alchemy
senses.definition: a person who tried to turn base metals into gold and to find a universal medicine, working before modern chemistry existed
senses.definitionCN: 试图把贱金属变成黄金并寻找万能药的人，其活动早于现代化学的出现
senses.example: The alchemist recorded every failure in a coded notebook.
senses.exampleCN: 这位炼金术士把每次失败都记在一本用暗语写的笔记里。
senses.why: Alchemy came from Arabic al-kimiya, the art of substances, and -ist marks the person who practises an art, so alchemist is the practiser of that art.
senses.whyCN: alchemy 来自阿拉伯语 al-kimiya「物质的技艺」，-ist 表示从事某种技艺的人，所以 alchemist 就是这门技艺的实践者。

senses.title: A worker of modern transformations
senses.definition: someone praised for turning ordinary material into something valuable, used figuratively of chefs, coaches and producers
senses.definitionCN: 因把普通材料变成有价值的东西而受称赞的人，比喻用于厨师、教练与制作人
senses.example: The producer is an alchemist who turns demos into hits.
senses.exampleCN: 这位制作人是点石成金的人，把小样变成热门歌曲。
senses.why: The furnace is gone but the transformation stays: we borrow the old figure whenever cheap input becomes precious output.
senses.whyCN: 炉子不见了，但「转化」留了下来：每当廉价投入变成珍贵产出，我们就借用这个古老形象。

intro.en: Alchemist travelled a long road: Greek chymeia, the art of pouring and mixing, prefixed by Arabic al-, the, then split by the suffix -ist into a person.
intro.cn: alchemist 走过一条长路：希腊语 chymeia「倾倒与混合的技艺」，加上阿拉伯语冠词 al-，再由后缀 -ist 分出「人」。

items.en: Greek chymeia meant the art of pouring and fusing metals, from chein, to pour.
items.cn: 希腊语 chymeia 指倾倒与熔合金属的技艺，源自 chein「倾倒」。

items.en: Arabic added the article al- to give al-kimiya, and the word entered Europe through translations made in Spain.
items.cn: 阿拉伯语加上冠词 al- 构成 al-kimiya，该词经西班牙的译本传入欧洲。

items.en: Scholarly Latin alchimia named the whole pursuit of transmutation and the elixir of life.
items.cn: 学术拉丁语 alchimia 指嬗变与长生药的全部追求。

items.en: Old French alquimiste added an agent ending to name the person practising the art.
items.cn: 古法语 alquimiste 加上表示行为者的词尾，指从事该技艺的人。

items.en: Middle English took the word in the fourteenth century, and Chaucer mocked such figures in his tales of the canon yeoman.
items.cn: 中古英语在十四世纪借入该词，乔叟在教士侍从的故事中嘲讽过这类人物。

items.en: Today alchemist is historical in its literal sense and admiring in its figurative one, while chemistry kept the science.
items.cn: 如今 alchemist 的字面义属历史，比喻义带赞赏，而 chemistry 保留了科学那一支。

note.en: The look-alike group keeps the alchem- family; the near-meaning group lists other words for someone who transforms or pretends to.
note.cn: 形近组保留 alchem- 词族；近义组列出其他表示「转化者或自称转化者」的词。

entries.definition: The old art of transmuting metals.
entries.definitionCN: 嬗变金属的古老技艺。

entries.definition: Relating to alchemy or its practices.
entries.definitionCN: 与炼金术或其实践有关的。

entries.definition: A scientist in chemistry, or a pharmacist.
entries.definitionCN: 化学家，或药剂师。

entries.definition: The supposed universal solvent of alchemy.
entries.definitionCN: 炼金术中假想的万能溶剂。

entries.definition: A person who performs apparent wonders.
entries.definitionCN: 表演看似奇迹的人。

entries.definition: A person claiming power over hidden forces.
entries.definitionCN: 自称能支配隐秘力量的人。

entries.definition: One who changes something completely.
entries.definitionCN: 彻底改变某物的人或物。

entries.definition: A person falsely claiming special skill.
entries.definitionCN: 谎称拥有特殊技能的人。

normalIntro.en: Alchemist is alchemy plus -ist: the person who does alchemy, the one at the furnace.
normalIntro.cn: alchemist 就是 alchemy 加 -ist：做炼金术的那个人，守在炉子边的人。

normal.en: -ist marks a practiser: chemist, artist and alchemist all name the person, not the subject.
normal.cn: -ist 表示从事者：chemist、artist、alchemist 都指人，不指学科。

normal.en: Alchemy is the art; alchemist is the artist. Drop -ist and you drop the person.
normal.cn: alchemy 是技艺，alchemist 是艺人。去掉 -ist 就去掉了人。

normal.en: The al- is the Arabic article the, the same al- you see in alcohol and algebra.
normal.cn: 这个 al- 是阿拉伯语冠词，与 alcohol、algebra 中的 al- 相同。

normal.en: Figuratively an alchemist turns cheap into precious, so praise a chef with it.
normal.cn: 比喻义上 alchemist 把廉价变珍贵，所以可以用它夸厨师。

normal.en: Do not confuse alchemist with chemist: one sought gold, the other studies matter.
normal.cn: 别把 alchemist 与 chemist 混淆：一个求黄金，一个研究物质。

abstract.en: Picture a man asleep beside a furnace that has burned for forty years.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人守在烧了四十年的炉子旁睡着。

abstract.en: Imagine a lead coin dropped into a pot and lifted out as gold.
abstract.cn: 想象一枚铅币放进锅里，捞出来时成了金币。

abstract.en: Think of a kitchen where leftovers come out as a banquet.
abstract.cn: 想象一间厨房，剩菜进去，宴席出来。

examples.en: The alchemist hid his recipes from rival workshops.
examples.cn: 这位炼金术士把配方藏起来，不让对手作坊看到。

examples.en: She called the editor an alchemist of forgotten manuscripts.
examples.cn: 她称这位编辑是被遗忘手稿的点金者。
