examples.en: Every alchemist dreamed of the philosopher's stone.
examples.cn: 每个炼金术士都梦想得到哲人石。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「阿尔凯米斯特」——阿尔（al）凯米（chemy）斯特（ist）：守着炉子的那个人，就是炼金术士。

root: 希腊语 chymeia「倾倒与熔合金属的技艺」加阿拉伯语冠词 al- 构成 al-kimiya，经中世纪拉丁语 alchimia 与古法语 alquimiste 进入英语，加表示行为者的 -ist 构成 alchemist，字面即「从事炼金术的人」。

sensesIntro.en: Both senses name a transformer: the literal one worked a furnace to change metal, and the figurative one works a kitchen, a studio or a training ground to change value.
sensesIntro.cn: 两个义项都指「转化者」：字面义守着炉子改变金属，比喻义在厨房、录音室或训练场上改变价值。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a person at the furnace turning lead into gold
core.cn: 核心意象：守在炉边把铅变成金的人

branches.en: A coded notebook of failed trials.
branches.cn: 一本记满失败试验的暗语笔记。

branches.en: A search for the elixir of life.
branches.cn: 对长生药的寻找。

branches.en: A chef turning scraps into a dish.
branches.cn: 厨师把边角料做成一道菜。

branches.en: A coach turning a weak side into winners.
branches.cn: 教练把弱队带成冠军。

branches.en: Both turn the cheap into the precious.
branches.cn: 两者都把廉价变成珍贵。

intro.en: Alchemist keeps three visible layers: the Arabic article al-, the Greek root chem- for fusing, and the agent suffix -ist.
intro.cn: alchemist 保留三个可见层次：阿拉伯语冠词 al-、表示熔合的希腊词根 chem-，以及表示行为者的后缀 -ist。

latinIntro.en: The word reached Latin as alchimia from Arabic al-kimiya, itself built on Greek chymeia.
latinIntro.cn: 该词以 alchimia 的形式从阿拉伯语 al-kimiya 进入拉丁语，而 al-kimiya 又建立在希腊语 chymeia 之上。

latinEntries.example: Alchimia carried the Arabic word into Latin.
latinEntries.exampleCN: alchimia 把阿拉伯语词带入拉丁语。

latinEntries.example: Chymeia comes from chein, to pour.
latinEntries.exampleCN: chymeia 源自 chein「倾倒」。

latinEntries.exampleCN: 法语形式为英语提供了词尾。

definition_zh: 炼金术；点石成金的技艺；神奇的转化力
definition_en: a medieval practice of trying to change base metals into gold, or any seemingly magical power of transformation
core_image: 幽暗地窖里的坩埚：铅在火中等待变成黄金的那一刻
scene: 地窖深处，炉火映着满墙的符文手稿。Medieval alchemy sought to turn lead into gold.
sceneCN: 这里 alchemy 是「炼金术」（第 1 个义项：中世纪试图把贱金属变成黄金的方术）；句意是中世纪炼金术试图将铅变成黄金。

pos.zh: 炼金术；（喻）神奇的转化

collocations.zh: 金融炼金术（虚幻的生财之道）

derivatives.zh: alchemy 加表示人的后缀 -ist，义为「炼金术士」
alchemy 加形容词后缀 -ical，义为「炼金术的；神奇的」
与 alchemy 同源的姊妹词，经阿拉伯语辗转传入，义为「化学」

senses.title: The medieval art of transmutation
senses.definition: the old practice of trying to turn common metals into gold and to find a universal cure
senses.definitionCN: 中世纪试图将贱金属炼成黄金并寻求万灵药的方术
senses.example: Princes kept alchemists hoping that alchemy would refill their treasuries.
senses.exampleCN: 君主们供养炼金术士，指望炼金术能填满国库。
senses.why: The Arabic article al- plus kīmiyā names the craft directly: 'the art of transmutation'.
senses.whyCN: 阿拉伯语定冠词 al- 加 kīmiyā 直接点明这门技艺：「转化之术」。

senses.title: Any seemingly magical transformation
senses.definition: a process that changes something in a mysterious or wonderful way
senses.definitionCN: 以神秘或奇妙的方式改变事物的过程
senses.example: There is a kind of alchemy in the way this kitchen turns leftovers into feasts.
senses.exampleCN: 这间厨房能把剩菜变成盛宴，简直有点石成金之妙。
senses.why: If alchemists could raise lead to gold, any astonishing upgrade earns the same name by metaphor.
senses.whyCN: 既然炼金术士能把铅炼成金，任何惊人的升华便可借喻得名。

intro.en: A Greek word for 'poured matter' that travelled through Arabic with its article fused on, then grew into both alchemy and chemistry.
intro.cn: 一个希腊词「浇注之物」，经阿拉伯语时冠词与之熔为一体传入欧洲，后来分出 alchemy 与 chemistry 两个词。

items.en: khēmeia or khumeia meant the art of pouring and mixing, later of transmuting metals; the exact spelling is debated.
items.cn: 希腊语 khēmeia 或 khumeia 意为「浇注混合之术」，后指金属转化术；拼写尚有争议。

items.en: Arabic al-kīmiyāʾ fused the definite article al- onto the borrowed word.
items.cn: 阿拉伯语 al-kīmiyāʾ 把定冠词 al- 熔接在借词之上。

items.en: Latin alchemia carried the Arabic form into European scholarship.
items.cn: 中世纪拉丁语 alchemia 把阿拉伯语形式带入欧洲学术。

items.en: Old French alquemie passed the word to English in the 14th century.
items.cn: 古法语 alquemie 于 14 世纪将该词传给英语。

items.en: The sibling chemistry split off for the science, leaving alchemy to the old art and its metaphor.
items.cn: 其姊妹词 chemistry 分出指称科学，alchemy 留给古方术及其比喻义。

note.en: The first group gathers the word's own offspring and sound-alikes; the second gathers words for mysterious transformation.
note.cn: 第一组收该词的后代词与音近词；第二组收表示「神秘转化」的词。

entries.definition: a person who practises alchemy
entries.definitionCN: 炼金术士

entries.definition: the science of substances, grown out of the same Arabic-Greek word
entries.definitionCN: 化学；与 alchemy 同出一源的姊妹词

entries.definition: an illusion or impossible fantasy; only sounds somewhat similar, unrelated root
entries.definitionCN: 幻想；空想；仅音近，词源无关

entries.definition: relating to alchemy, or magically transformative
entries.definitionCN: 炼金术的；有神奇转化力的

entries.definition: supernatural power, or an enchanting quality
entries.definitionCN: 魔法；魅力

entries.definition: the act of changing one thing into another, the literal goal of alchemy
entries.definitionCN: 嬗变；转化，炼金术的字面目标

entries.definition: the use of magic, often with dark overtones
entries.definitionCN: 巫术；妖术，常带阴暗色彩

entries.definition: magical skill, or extraordinary technical skill
entries.definitionCN: 魔法技艺；（喻）高超本领

entries.definition: a thorough or dramatic change in form or nature
entries.definitionCN: 彻底的改变；变形

normalIntro.en: The al- is the Arabic article 'the', and the rest became chemistry too.
normalIntro.cn: al- 是阿拉伯语定冠词「the」，剩下的部分后来又派生了 chemistry。

normal.en: alchemy and chemistry are twins from one Arabic word.
normal.cn: alchemy 与 chemistry 是同一个阿拉伯词的双生子。

normal.en: alchemist is the person, alchemical the adjective.
normal.cn: alchemist 是人，alchemical 是形容词。

normal.en: Many al- words came from Arabic: alcohol, algebra, alkali.
normal.cn: 许多 al- 开头的词都来自阿拉伯语：alcohol、algebra、alkali。

normal.en: The goal was transmutation: lead into gold.
normal.cn: 其目标是嬗变：点铅成金。

normal.en: Figuratively, alchemy is any wonderful upgrading.
normal.cn: 比喻义上，alchemy 指任何奇妙的升华。

abstract.en: Picture a bubbling crucible glowing orange in a dark cellar.
abstract.cn: 想象幽暗地窖里咕嘟作响、泛着橙光的坩埚。

abstract.en: See grey lead sinking into the pot and a gold coin rising out.
abstract.cn: 想象灰铅沉入锅底，一枚金币浮出水面。

abstract.en: Imagine yesterday's scraps arriving at the table as a banquet.
abstract.cn: 想象昨天的剩料上桌时已成一场盛宴。

examples.en: Isaac Newton devoted years to alchemy.
examples.cn: 牛顿曾花费多年研究炼金术。

examples.en: The novel describes the alchemy of grief into art.
examples.cn: 这部小说描写了把悲恸炼成艺术的转化。

examples.en: Critics dismissed the budget as financial alchemy.
examples.cn: 批评者斥这份预算为金融炼金术。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「爱啊渴没」——爱金如渴的术士，最后炼金术没成，化学成了。

root: 希腊语 khēmeia/khumeia「浇注混合之术」借入阿拉伯语为 al-kīmiyāʾ（冠词 al- 熔合），经中世纪拉丁语 alchemia 与古法语 alquemie 于 14 世纪进入英语；同源姊妹词 chemistry 后指科学。

sensesIntro.en: Two senses run from furnace to metaphor: the literal art of making gold, then any wonderful change worth the same name.
sensesIntro.cn: 两个义项从熔炉走向比喻：先是炼金本业，再是一切当得起此名的奇妙转变。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a crucible in a dark cellar, lead waiting to become gold.
core.cn: 核心意象：幽暗地窖中的坩埚，铅在等待成为黄金。

branches.en: a royal alchemist at a smoking furnace
branches.cn: 在冒着烟的炉前劳作的御用炼金术士

branches.en: manuscripts of symbols and formulas for gold
branches.cn: 写满炼金符号与配方的手稿

branches.en: a kitchen turning scraps into a feast
branches.cn: 把剩料变成盛宴的厨房

branches.en: grief refined into music
branches.cn: 被提炼成音乐的悲恸

branches.en: one promised transformation, in metal or in life
branches.cn: 同一种被许诺的转化，或在金属，或在人生

intro.en: An Arabic definite article welded to a Greek root, with English endings building the family.
intro.cn: 阿拉伯语定冠词焊接在希腊词根上，英语词尾再构筑词族。

latinIntro.en: alchemia is the medieval Latin form through which the word arrived.
latinIntro.cn: alchemia 是该词传入时经由的中世纪拉丁形式。

definition_zh: 酒精；乙醇；含酒精饮料；（化学）醇
definition_en: the colourless liquid in drinks that makes people drunk, drinks containing it, or a class of chemical compounds
core_image: 一只玻璃瓶里透明的液体，标签上只有一行成分说明
scene: 餐桌上摆着一排玻璃杯，有人正往里倒透明液体，冰块碰出轻响。The doctor asked how much alcohol he drank each week.
sceneCN: 这里 alcohol 是「酒精、含酒精饮料」（第 2 个义项：含有乙醇的饮品）；句意为医生问他每周喝多少酒。图中可辨识物件：玻璃杯、冰块、酒瓶。

pos.zh: 名词：酒精；乙醇；含酒精饮料；（化学）醇

derivatives.zh: 由本词加形容词后缀构成，义为「含酒精的；酗酒的」
由本词加表示病态的 suffix 构成，义为「酒精中毒；酗酒成瘾」
由本词与 free 合成，义为「不含酒精的」

senses.title: The intoxicating substance itself
senses.definition: the colourless liquid, ethanol, that is the active substance in drinks and is also used as a solvent
senses.definitionCN: 无色液体乙醇，是酒类中的有效成分，也用作溶剂
senses.example: This cleaner contains alcohol and should not be used near a flame.
senses.exampleCN: 这种清洁剂含酒精，不应在明火附近使用。
senses.why: This is the chemical sense, and it comes straight from the Arabic word for a fine powder once used as eye make-up: the liquid was first obtained by distillation.
senses.whyCN: 这是化学义，直接来自阿拉伯语中一种曾作眼影的细粉之名：这种液体最早正是通过蒸馏取得的。

senses.title: Drinks that contain it
senses.definition: drinks such as beer, wine, or spirits that contain ethanol
senses.definitionCN: 啤酒、葡萄酒、烈酒等含乙醇的饮品
senses.example: The doctor asked how much alcohol he drank each week.
senses.exampleCN: 医生问他每周喝多少酒。
senses.why: Since the substance is what makes a drink alcoholic, the name of the substance became a general word for the drinks themselves.
senses.whyCN: 既然正是这种物质让饮品带酒劲，物质之名便成了一类饮品的总称。

senses.title: A class of chemical compounds
senses.definition: in chemistry, any of a large class of organic compounds containing a hydroxyl group
senses.definitionCN: 化学中含有羟基的一类有机化合物
senses.example: Sugar alcohols are used as sweeteners in many processed foods.
senses.exampleCN: 糖醇被用作许多加工食品的甜味剂。
senses.why: Chemists generalised the name from ethanol to the whole family, so any compound built on the same pattern counts as an alcohol.
senses.whyCN: 化学家把这个名字从乙醇推广到整个家族，凡是按同一结构组成的化合物都算一种 alcohol。

intro.en: Alcohol began as an Arabic word for a fine powder used as eye make-up, and only later became the name of a distilled liquid.
intro.cn: alcohol 原是一个阿拉伯语词，指用作眼影的细粉，后来才成为蒸馏液体的名称。

items.en: Al-kuhl named a fine powder of antimony used to darken the eyelids, and by extension anything finely refined.
items.cn: al-kuḥl 指一种用于描黑眼睑的锑粉，并引申指任何精细提炼之物。

items.en: Alchemists borrowed the word for a finely purified substance, and used it for spirits obtained by distillation.
items.cn: 炼金术士借这个词指精细提纯之物，并用它称呼蒸馏所得的烈性液体。

items.en: English alcohol first names a powder and then, from the sixteenth century, a distilled spirit.
items.cn: 英语 alcohol 先指粉末，十六世纪起指蒸馏酒。

items.en: Chemistry fixed the word on ethanol, the substance in wine and beer that causes drunkenness.
items.cn: 化学把这个词固定在乙醇上，即葡萄酒与啤酒中致醉的那种物质。

items.en: The word widened again to drinks in general and to the whole chemical class of alcohols.
items.cn: 这个词再度扩展，既泛指酒类，也指整个醇类化合物。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words built on alcohol; the near-meaning group gathers the substance and the drinks in other words.
note.cn: 形近组收由 alcohol 构成的词；近义组收这种物质与酒类的其他说法。

entries.definition: Containing alcohol, or a person dependent on it.
entries.definitionCN: 含酒精的，或指对酒精依赖的人。

entries.definition: The illness of being unable to control one's drinking.
entries.definitionCN: 无法控制饮酒的疾病。

entries.definition: A related class of chemical compounds, named from alcohol and dehydrogenated.
entries.definitionCN: 一类相关化合物，名称由 alcohol 与「脱氢」缩合而成。

entries.definition: The precise chemical name for the alcohol in drinks.
entries.definitionCN: 酒类中所含酒精的精确化学名称。

entries.definition: Strong distilled drink such as whisky or gin.
entries.definitionCN: 威士忌、金酒之类的蒸馏烈酒。

entries.definition: Strong alcoholic drinks, in a formal or trade sense.
entries.definitionCN: 烈酒，多用于正式或行业语境。

normalIntro.en: Two real layers carry the word: Arabic al-kuhl, a fine powder, and the alchemists' use of it for distilled liquid.
normalIntro.cn: 两个真实层次承载这个词：阿拉伯语 al-kuḥl 指细粉，以及炼金术士用它称呼蒸馏液。

normal.en: The al- at the start is the Arabic article, the same one as in algebra and alchemy.
normal.cn: 开头的 al- 是阿拉伯语冠词，与 algebra、alchemy 中的那个 al- 是同一个。

normal.en: The word travelled from eye make-up to distilled liquid to the drinks on the table.
normal.cn: 这个词从眼影走到蒸馏液，再走到餐桌上的酒。

normal.en: Chemists kept the name for the whole family, so methanol and sugar alcohols count too.
normal.cn: 化学家把名字留给了整个家族，所以甲醇与糖醇也算。

normal.en: Alcohol is uncountable for the substance and countable for the chemical compounds.
normal.cn: 指这种物质时不可数，指具体化合物时可数。

normal.en: Do not double the l: a-l-c-o-h-o-l.
normal.cn: 不要写双 l：a-l-c-o-h-o-l。

abstract.en: A word for cosmetics became a word for chemistry and then for a social problem, which is a long journey for one noun.
abstract.cn: 一个化妆品词变成化学词，又变成社会问题词，这对一个名词来说是很长的旅程。

abstract.en: The same substance is a solvent, a drink and a health risk, and the word refuses to separate them.
abstract.cn: 同一种物质既是溶剂、又是饮品、又是健康风险，而这个词拒绝把它们分开。

abstract.en: Naming the substance rather than the drink is a way of making a social habit sound clinical.
abstract.cn: 用物质而非饮品来命名，是一种让社交习惯听起来像临床问题的方式。

examples.en: The doctor asked how much alcohol he drank each week.
examples.cn: 医生问他每周喝多少酒。

examples.en: This cleaner contains alcohol and should not be used near a flame.
examples.cn: 这种清洁剂含酒精，不应在明火附近使用。

examples.en: Sugar alcohols are used as sweeteners in many processed foods.
examples.cn: 糖醇被用作许多加工食品的甜味剂。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「爱抠喝」——爱抠着瓶子喝的人，桌上少不了酒精。

root: 源自阿拉伯语 al-kuḥl「锑粉、精细提炼之物」，经中世纪拉丁语进入英语，先指粉末，后指蒸馏酒，最终固定为乙醇。

sensesIntro.en: One substance runs through all three senses: the chemical itself, the drinks built on it, and the whole family of related compounds.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项贯穿着同一种物质：化学物质本身、以它为基础的饮品，以及整个相关的化合物家族。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a glass bottle of clear liquid with nothing on the label but a chemical formula.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只装着透明液体的玻璃瓶，标签上只有一行化学式。

branches.en: a swab of clear liquid on a laboratory bench
branches.cn: 实验台上的一小摊透明液体

branches.en: glasses filled at a dinner table
branches.cn: 餐桌上被斟满的杯子

branches.en: a bottle kept on the top shelf
branches.cn: 放在最上层架子上的那瓶酒

branches.en: a formula written on a whiteboard
branches.cn: 白板上写下的一条化学式

branches.en: one liquid, named by its chemistry and by its effects
branches.cn: 同一种液体，既按化学命名，也按效果命名

intro.en: An Arabic article and noun, their Latin and English descendants, and the endings that build the family.
intro.cn: 阿拉伯语冠词与名词、它们的拉丁语与英语后裔，以及构成词族的词尾。

latinIntro.en: The word entered Latin from Arabic as alcohol; it is not a native Latin root.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词从阿拉伯语进入拉丁语作 alcohol，并非拉丁语本族词根。

items.meaning: ethanol, drink, or a chemical class
containing alcohol, or a dependent drinker

definition_zh: 酗酒成瘾；酒瘾；慢性酒精中毒
definition_en: a condition in which a person cannot control drinking and suffers when it stops; also the chronic physical damage caused by years of heavy drinking
core_image: 酒杯一旦放下就浑身难受的那种依赖
scene: 他戒了三次又复发，家人已经不敢再数。Alcoholism cost him his job and his marriage.
sceneCN: 这里 alcoholism 是「酗酒成瘾」（第 1 个义项：对酒精形成依赖、无法自控的疾病状态）；句意为酗酒让他丢了工作也毁了婚姻。核心画面是酒杯一旦放下就浑身难受的那种依赖。

pos.zh: 酗酒成瘾；酒瘾；酒精中毒

forms.label: 不可数名词，无复数形式

derivatives.zh: 相关形容词，义为「酒精的；酗酒的」
去掉 -ism 的物质名词，义为「酒精；含酒精饮料」
加 non- 构成，义为「不含酒精的」

senses.title: Dependence on drinking
senses.definition: a condition in which a person cannot control drinking and suffers when it stops, treated as a disease rather than a weakness
senses.definitionCN: 一个人无法控制饮酒、停饮即出现痛苦反应的状态，被视为疾病而非意志薄弱
senses.example: Alcoholism runs in his family on both sides.
senses.exampleCN: 他父母两边家族都有酗酒问题。
senses.why: Alcohol plus -ism names a settled condition, the same suffix that gives rheumatism and absenteeism their sense of a lasting state.
senses.whyCN: alcohol 加 -ism 表示一种固定状态，这个后缀在 rheumatism、absenteeism 中同样表示持续的状态。

senses.title: Chronic poisoning by alcohol
senses.definition: the physical damage done by years of heavy drinking, the older medical sense covering liver, nerve and brain injury
senses.definitionCN: 长年大量饮酒造成的身体损害，是较旧的医学用法，涵盖肝、神经与脑损伤
senses.example: The scan showed signs of alcoholism in the liver.
senses.exampleCN: 扫描显示肝脏有酒精中毒的迹象。
senses.why: Here -ism keeps its medical use of naming a morbid condition, so the word points at the damage rather than at the habit.
senses.whyCN: 这里 -ism 保留了医学上表示病态的用法，所以该词指向损害本身，而不是饮酒习惯。

intro.en: Alcoholism is alcohol plus the condition suffix -ism: the substance word came from Arabic kohl, a fine powder, and alchemists later stretched it to the spirit of wine.
intro.cn: alcoholism 是 alcohol 加表示状态的后缀 -ism：这个物质词来自阿拉伯语 kohl「细粉」，炼金术士后来把它引申为「酒的精粹」。

items.en: Arabic al-kuhl named a fine powder of antimony used to stain the eyelids, the source of kohl.
items.cn: 阿拉伯语 al-kuhl 指用于染眼睑的锑细粉，是 kohl 的来源。

items.en: Scholarly Latin alcohol kept the powder sense, then alchemists used it for any substance refined to its essence.
items.cn: 学术拉丁语 alcohol 保留细粉义，后来炼金术士用它指任何提炼到精粹的物质。

items.en: The phrase alcohol vini, the essence of wine, narrowed the word to the spirit drawn off by distillation.
items.cn: 短语 alcohol vini「酒的精粹」把该词收窄为蒸馏得到的酒精。

items.en: English took alcohol in the sixteenth century for the powder, and by the seventeenth for the active spirit in drink.
items.cn: 英语在十六世纪借入 alcohol 指细粉，到十七世纪指酒中的活性精粹。

items.en: The Swedish physician Magnus Huss coined the term in the middle of the nineteenth century to describe chronic drinking as a disease.
items.cn: 瑞典医生马格努斯·胡斯在十九世纪中叶创制该词，把长期饮酒描述为一种疾病。

items.en: Modern medicine treats alcoholism as a dependence syndrome, and the phrase alcohol use disorder is now preferred in clinics.
items.cn: 现代医学把 alcoholism 视为依赖综合征，临床上如今更常用 alcohol use disorder 这一说法。

note.en: The look-alike group keeps the alcohol family; the near-meaning group lists other words for dependence and for harmful drinking.
note.cn: 形近组保留 alcohol 词族；近义组列出其他表示「依赖」与「有害饮酒」的词。

entries.definition: The intoxicating substance in drinks.
entries.definitionCN: 饮料中令人醉的物质。

entries.definition: Containing alcohol, or relating to dependence on it.
entries.definitionCN: 含酒精的，或与酒精依赖有关的。

entries.definition: To treat or saturate with alcohol.
entries.definitionCN: 用酒精处理或浸透。

entries.definition: A nitrogen compound found in plants.
entries.definitionCN: 植物中含氮的化合物。

entries.definition: A compulsive dependence on a substance.
entries.definitionCN: 对某种物质的强迫性依赖。

entries.definition: The state of needing something to function.
entries.definitionCN: 需要某物才能正常运作的状态。

entries.definition: An uncontrollable craving for drink.
entries.definitionCN: 无法控制的饮酒渴求。

entries.definition: Lack of restraint, especially in drinking.
entries.definitionCN: 缺乏节制，尤指饮酒。

normalIntro.en: Alcoholism is alcohol plus -ism: the condition of being ruled by alcohol.
normalIntro.cn: alcoholism 就是 alcohol 加 -ism：被酒精支配的状态。

normal.en: -ism names a condition here, as in rheumatism, not a belief as in Buddhism.
normal.cn: 这里的 -ism 表示状态，如 rheumatism，而不是信仰，如 Buddhism 中的用法。

normal.en: Alcohol is the substance; alcoholism is the disease. One is a bottle, the other a diagnosis.
normal.cn: alcohol 是物质，alcoholism 是疾病：一个是瓶子，一个是诊断。

normal.en: It is uncountable, so say treat alcoholism, not treat an alcoholism.
normal.cn: 它不可数，所以说 treat alcoholism，不说 treat an alcoholism。

normal.en: An alcoholic is a person; alcoholism is what the person has.
normal.cn: alcoholic 指人，alcoholism 指这个人所患的病。

normal.en: Clinics now often prefer alcohol use disorder, but alcoholism remains common.
normal.cn: 临床上如今常用 alcohol use disorder，但 alcoholism 仍很普遍。

abstract.en: Picture a glass that refills itself whenever the hand puts it down.
abstract.cn: 想象一只杯子，手一放下它就自己重新斟满。

abstract.en: Imagine a hook set in the throat that only drink can loosen.
abstract.cn: 想象喉咙里卡着一个钩子，只有酒能把它松开。

abstract.en: Think of a calendar where every crossed-out day hides a bottle.
abstract.cn: 想象一本日历，每个划掉的日子背后都藏着一个酒瓶。

examples.en: He has been in recovery from alcoholism for six years.
examples.cn: 他从酒瘾中康复已有六年。

examples.en: Alcoholism is treatable, but relapse is common.
examples.cn: 酗酒可以治疗，但复发很常见。

examples.en: The clinic screens every patient for alcoholism.
examples.cn: 诊所对每位病人都做酗酒筛查。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「阿尔可霍利曾」——阿尔可（alco）霍（hol）利曾（ism）：酒（alcohol）变成一种缠人的状态（ism），就是酗酒成瘾。

root: 阿拉伯语 al-kuhl「染眼睑的锑细粉」经中世纪拉丁语 alcohol 引申为「提炼出的精粹」，短语 alcohol vini 把它收窄为蒸馏酒精；十九世纪医学加表示病态的后缀 -ism 构成 alcoholism，字面即「酒精造成的持续病态」。

sensesIntro.en: Both senses describe what alcohol does over time: one names the dependence that keeps a person drinking, the other names the physical damage that drinking leaves behind.
sensesIntro.cn: 两个义项都在描述酒精随时间造成的结果：一个指让人不断喝下去的依赖，一个指饮酒留下的身体损害。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a dependence that will not let the glass go
core.cn: 核心意象：一种不肯放下酒杯的依赖

branches.en: Craving that returns each evening.
branches.cn: 每晚都会回来的渴求。

branches.en: Shaking hands when the drink stops.
branches.cn: 停饮时发抖的双手。

branches.en: A liver scarred by years of drinking.
branches.cn: 被多年饮酒损伤的肝脏。

branches.en: Nerve damage that shows in the walk.
branches.cn: 从步态上看得出的神经损伤。

branches.en: Both name a lasting condition, not one night.
branches.cn: 两者都指持续状态，而非某一个夜晚。

intro.en: Alcoholism is alcohol plus -ism, where -ism turns a substance into the lasting condition that substance produces.
intro.cn: alcoholism 是 alcohol 加 -ism，这里的 -ism 把一种物质变成它所造成的持续状态。

latinIntro.en: Medieval Latin alcohol first meant a fine powder and then any refined essence; the phrase alcohol vini fixed the modern sense.
latinIntro.cn: 中世纪拉丁语 alcohol 先指细粉，后指任何提炼出的精粹；短语 alcohol vini 确定了现代词义。

latinEntries.example: Alcohol first meant a powdered antimony.
latinEntries.exampleCN: alcohol 最初指锑细粉。

latinEntries.example: The phrase narrowed alcohol to spirits.
latinEntries.exampleCN: 该短语把 alcohol 收窄为烈酒。

definition_zh: 警觉的；机敏的；警报；提醒；使警觉
definition_en: watchful and quick to notice things, a warning of danger, or to warn someone
core_image: 守夜人站在塔顶，耳朵转向黑暗里最轻的一声响
scene: 夜里仓库的灯忽然全亮了，值班的人抓起对讲机。A security alert emptied the building within minutes.
sceneCN: 这里 alert 是「警报」（第 2 个义项：提示危险、要求立即行动的警告）；句意为一条安全警报让整栋楼在几分钟内清空。图中可辨识物件：对讲机、应急灯、仓库门。

pos.zh: 形容词：警觉的；机敏的
名词：警报；警戒状态
动词：使警觉；提醒；向……报警

derivatives.zh: 由本词加副词后缀构成，义为「警觉地」
由本词加名词后缀构成，义为「警觉；机敏」
由 hyper- 加本词构成，义为「过度警觉的」

senses.title: Watchful and quick
senses.definition: paying close attention and ready to notice or react to something quickly
senses.definitionCN: 高度注意、能迅速察觉或反应的状态
senses.example: Drivers must stay alert on long night journeys.
senses.exampleCN: 长途夜间行车时司机必须保持警觉。
senses.why: The Italian source is a military lookout phrase, 'on the watch', so the adjective began as a description of a guard on duty.
senses.whyCN: 这个词的意大利语来源是军中的瞭望口令「处在警戒中」，所以形容词最初描述的是值班的哨兵。

senses.title: A warning of danger
senses.definition: a warning or announcement that danger or an emergency is present
senses.definitionCN: 告知危险或紧急情况存在的警告或通告
senses.example: A security alert emptied the building within minutes.
senses.exampleCN: 一条安全警报让整栋楼在几分钟内清空。
senses.why: The lookout's shout became the message itself, so the noun names the warning rather than the watchman.
senses.whyCN: 哨兵的喊声变成了讯息本身，于是名词指的是那条警告，而不是守望的人。

senses.title: To warn someone
senses.definition: to warn someone about a danger or to make them aware of something urgent
senses.definitionCN: 就危险警告某人，或使其意识到紧急情况
senses.example: A neighbour alerted us to the smoke in the hallway.
senses.exampleCN: 一位邻居提醒我们走廊里有烟。
senses.why: The verb gives the warning a direction: the lookout's cry is now aimed at a particular person.
senses.whyCN: 动词给警告加上了方向：哨兵的喊声如今是对着某个具体的人发出的。

intro.en: Alert comes from an Italian military phrase meaning 'on the watch', and it still sounds like a sentry's word.
intro.cn: alert 来自一个意为「处在警戒中」的意大利军事短语，至今听起来仍像哨兵的用语。

items.en: All'erta meant 'on the height, on the watch', the position of a lookout on a tower.
items.cn: all'erta 意为「在高处、在警戒中」，指哨兵在塔上的位置。

items.en: French took the phrase as alerte, naming both the watch and the warning cry.
items.cn: 法语借作 alerte，既指警戒，也指警告的喊声。

items.en: English borrowed alerte first as a military order and soon as an adjective meaning watchful.
items.cn: 英语先借作军事口令，很快又用作表示「警觉的」形容词。

items.en: The noun widened to civilian warnings, from fire to weather, and the verb followed.
items.cn: 名词从军事扩展到民用的火警、天气等警告，动词随后出现。

items.en: Modern use ranges from a phone alert to a doctor's alertness, all from the same lookout post.
items.cn: 现代用法从手机警报一直到医生的警觉度，全都出自同一个瞭望岗位。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words built on alert; the near-meaning group gathers watchfulness and warnings.
note.cn: 形近组收由 alert 构成的词；近义组收警觉与警告类词。

entries.definition: The state of being watchful and quick to react.
entries.definitionCN: 警觉、反应迅速的状态。

entries.definition: In a watchful, attentive manner.
entries.definitionCN: 以警觉、专注的方式。

entries.definition: A warning device or the fear it causes.
entries.definitionCN: 警报装置，或它引起的恐惧。

entries.definition: Very careful to notice danger, especially over a long period.
entries.definitionCN: 长期保持警惕、留意危险的。

entries.definition: Attentive and looking out for possible trouble.
entries.definitionCN: 留心、注意可能出现的麻烦的。

entries.definition: A statement or sign that danger may be coming.
entries.definitionCN: 提示危险可能来临的话语或标志。

normalIntro.en: Two real parts carry the word: the Italian phrase all'erta and its French reshaping alerte.
normalIntro.cn: 两个真实部件承载这个词：意大利短语 all'erta 及其法语改写 alerte。

normal.en: Alert and alarm are cousins: one is the watch, the other the cry.
normal.cn: alert 与 alarm 是表亲：一个是守望，一个是呼喊。

normal.en: All'erta means 'on the height', so alert began as a position on a tower.
normal.cn: all'erta 意为「在高处」，所以 alert 最初是塔上的一个位置。

normal.en: Stay alert is an instruction to the eyes and ears, not to the feet.
normal.cn: stay alert 是对眼睛和耳朵下的指令，不是对脚。

normal.en: On alert is the state; an alert is the message; to alert is the action.
normal.cn: on alert 是状态，an alert 是讯息，to alert 是动作。

normal.en: One l, then e: a-l-e-r-t, not allert.
normal.cn: 一个 l 后接 e：a-l-e-r-t，不是 allert。

abstract.en: Alertness is a form of attention that assumes something may go wrong, which is why guards and editors both need it.
abstract.cn: 警觉是一种预设「可能出事」的注意力，所以哨兵与编辑都需要它。

abstract.en: The same word is a state, a message and an action, because a warning only exists across all three.
abstract.cn: 同一个词既是状态、又是讯息、又是动作，因为警告正是在这三者之间才成立。

abstract.en: A society that is permanently on alert eventually stops noticing the alerts.
abstract.cn: 长期处于警戒状态的社会，最终会不再注意那些警报。

examples.en: Drivers must stay alert on long night journeys.
examples.cn: 长途夜间行车时司机必须保持警觉。

examples.en: A security alert emptied the building within minutes.
examples.cn: 一条安全警报让整栋楼在几分钟内清空。

examples.en: A neighbour alerted us to the smoke in the hallway.
examples.cn: 一位邻居提醒我们走廊里有烟。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「额，勒特」——额，勒特一听见动静就竖起耳朵，特别警觉。

root: 源自意大利语军事短语 all'erta「在高处、在警戒中」，经法语 alerte 进入英语，由「瞭望」引申为警觉、警报与报警。

sensesIntro.en: One lookout post produces all three senses: the guard's state, the cry he raises, and the act of raising it for someone else.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项都出自同一个瞭望岗位：哨兵的状态、他发出的喊声，以及替别人发出喊声的动作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a watchman on a tower turns his ear towards the faintest sound in the dark.
core.cn: 核心意象：塔上的守夜人把耳朵转向黑暗中那一声最轻的响动。

branches.en: a driver's eyes moving between mirror and road
branches.cn: 在后视镜与路面之间移动的司机目光

branches.en: a siren and a message on every phone
branches.cn: 响起的警报与每部手机上的通知

branches.en: a neighbour knocking hard on the door
branches.cn: 用力敲门的邻居

branches.en: a red light spinning above an entrance
branches.cn: 门口上方旋转的红灯

branches.en: one watchfulness, kept and passed on
branches.cn: 同一种警觉，自己保持，也传给别人

intro.en: An Italian phrase of place, its French form, and the English endings built on the borrowed word.
intro.cn: 一个表示位置的意大利短语、它的法语形式，以及建在这个借词上的英语词尾。

latinIntro.en: The phrase is Italian; erta goes back to Latin erectus, 'raised', so the list gives that Latin source.
latinIntro.cn: 这个短语属意大利语；erta 可追到拉丁语 erectus「竖起的」，因此列表给出这一拉丁来源。

items.meaning: on the height, on the watch

definition_zh: 藻类（总称）；单细胞藻（微藻）；大型海藻；淡水藻；藻华与赤潮；生物燃料与养殖；共生藻；化石藻与古环境
definition_en: the large and varied group of mainly aquatic organisms that photosynthesise without true roots, stems or leaves, ranging from single cells to seaweeds
core_image: 退潮后的礁石上覆着一层滑腻的褐绿色薄膜，远处海带的长带随浪摆动
scene: 退潮后的礁石上覆着一层滑腻的褐绿色薄膜，浅水里还有成片的长带随浪摆动。At low tide the rocks are covered with a slippery brown-green film of algae, and longer ribbons sway in the shallows.
sceneCN: 这里 algae 指「附生在湿石与浅水中的藻类」（第 1 个义项：藻类总称，从单细胞到大型海藻）；句意：退潮时岩石上覆着一层滑腻的褐绿色藻膜，较长的带状藻体在浅水中摆动。图中可辨识物件：退潮后的礁石、褐绿色薄膜、浅水、随浪摆动的长带状藻体。

pos.zh: 藻类（拉丁复数，常作集合名词，指从单细胞到大型海藻的一大类光合生物）
藻（拉丁单数 alga 的复数形式，指一个或多个藻体）

derivatives.zh: 藻的；藻类的
藻类学
藻类学家
褐藻胶；褐藻酸盐（从褐藻中提取的增稠剂）
藻类养殖

senses.title: The group as a whole
senses.titleCN: 藻类总称（一大类行光合作用的水生生物）
senses.definition: the whole assemblage of photosynthetic organisms that lack true roots, stems and leaves, from single cells to giant kelps
senses.definitionCN: 一大类没有真正的根、茎、叶而行光合作用的生物总体，从单细胞到巨型海带都包括在内
senses.example: At low tide the rocks are covered with a slippery brown-green film of algae, and longer ribbons sway in the shallows.
senses.exampleCN: 退潮时岩石上覆着一层滑腻的褐绿色藻膜，较长的带状藻体在浅水中摆动。
senses.why: the Latin plural is used collectively for the group, exactly as a class name is used in botany.
senses.whyCN: 这个拉丁复数被用作整类的集合名称，正如植物学中使用类群名那样。

senses.title: Single-celled algae
senses.definition: one-celled forms such as diatoms and green flagellates, often cultured or counted cell by cell
senses.definitionCN: 硅藻、绿色鞭毛藻这类单细胞形态，常被培养或逐个细胞计数
senses.example: Single-celled algae in the pond were small enough to pass through the filter.
senses.exampleCN: 池里的单细胞藻小到能穿过滤网。
senses.why: because the plural can be counted, it names individual cells when the context is a sample or a culture.
senses.whyCN: 复数可以计数，因此在样品或培养的语境中它就指一个个细胞。

senses.title: Seaweeds and large attached forms
senses.definition: large multicellular algae attached to rock or seabed, with holdfasts and fronds rather than roots and leaves
senses.definitionCN: 附着在岩石或海底的大型多细胞藻，以固着器与叶状体代替根和叶
senses.example: Brown algae along this coast form dense beds at the low-tide line.
senses.exampleCN: 这一带的褐藻在低潮线形成密集藻床。
senses.why: the same plural covers the seaweeds because they are algae by descent, only larger and attached.
senses.whyCN: 海藻在亲缘上仍是藻，只是更大且附着生长，因此同一个复数也涵盖它们。

senses.title: Freshwater algae
senses.definition: algae of lakes, rivers and ponds, including green filaments and cyanobacterial mats that float or coat surfaces
senses.definitionCN: 湖泊、河流与池塘中的藻，包括漂浮或覆盖表面的绿色丝状体与蓝细菌藻席
senses.example: Filamentous green algae choked the shallow end of the lake.
senses.exampleCN: 丝状绿藻塞满了湖的浅水端。
senses.why: habitat rather than form separates this use: the word stays the same, only the water changes.
senses.whyCN: 这一用法靠生境而非形态区分：词形不变，只是水换了。

senses.title: Bloom and red tide
senses.definition: a mass proliferation of algae that discolours water, depletes oxygen or releases toxins harmful to fish and people
senses.definitionCN: 藻类大规模增殖，使水变色、耗尽氧气或释放对鱼与人有害的毒素
senses.example: Toxic algae closed the shellfish beds for a month.
senses.exampleCN: 有毒藻类使贝类养殖区关闭了一个月。
senses.why: when the group multiplies out of control it becomes an event, and the class name is used for that event.
senses.whyCN: 当这一类群失控增殖，它就成了一个事件，类群名便被用来指该事件。

senses.title: Cultivation, feed and fuel
senses.titleCN: 藻类养殖、饲料与生物燃料
senses.definition: algae grown in ponds or closed reactors for oil, animal feed, fertiliser or wastewater treatment
senses.definitionCN: 在池塘或密闭反应器中培养的藻，用于制油、做饲料、作肥料或处理废水
senses.example: Algae grown in shallow ponds can be harvested for oil.
senses.exampleCN: 在浅池中培养的藻可收获用于制油。
senses.why: from the wild group the word passes to the industrial crop, because the same organisms are now farmed.
senses.whyCN: 从野生类群过渡到工业作物，因为被养殖的正是同一批生物。

senses.title: Symbiotic algae inside other organisms
senses.titleCN: 共生藻（地衣、珊瑚体内的藻）
senses.definition: algae living inside lichens, corals or sponges, giving them photosynthesis in exchange for shelter
senses.definitionCN: 生活在地衣、珊瑚或海绵体内的藻，以光合产物换取庇护
senses.example: Algae living in coral tissues supply most of the reef's energy.
senses.exampleCN: 生活在珊瑚组织里的藻提供礁体的大部分能量。
senses.why: the relationship, not the habitat, defines this use: the algae are inside another body.
senses.whyCN: 定义这一用法的是共生关系而非生境：藻在另一个生物体内。

senses.title: Fossil algae and ancient environments
senses.definition: algal remains such as stromatolites, diatomite and calcareous nannofossils used to date rocks and reconstruct past water
senses.definitionCN: 叠层石、硅藻土与钙质超微化石这类藻类遗存，用于测定岩层年代与重建古水体
senses.example: Fossil algae in the core showed that the lake had once been saline.
senses.exampleCN: 岩芯中的化石藻表明这个湖曾经是咸水。
senses.why: hard parts and mats preserve well, so the group name also covers its fossil record and the evidence it provides.
senses.whyCN: 坚硬部分与藻席易于保存，因此类群名也涵盖其化石记录与所提供的证据。

intro.en: Algae is the Latin plural of alga 'seaweed, water plant', borrowed into English in the seventeenth century and used collectively ever since. The deeper origin of Latin alga is uncertain: no Indo-European source is agreed, and comparisons with other words for seaweed are hypotheses.
intro.cn: algae 是拉丁语 alga「海藻、水草」的复数，17 世纪借入英语，此后一直作集合名词使用。拉丁 alga 的更深来源不确定：没有公认的印欧语语源，与其它语言中「海藻」词的比较均属假说。

items.en: Latin alga is recorded for seaweed and water plants in classical texts. Its deeper origin is uncertain, and proposals linking it to other European words for seaweed are unproven.
items.cn: 拉丁语 alga 在古典文本中已用于指海藻与水草。其更深来源不确定，把它与其它欧洲语言中「海藻」词相联系的提议未获证实。

items.en: Alga belongs to the first declension, so its nominative plural is algae; English took the plural form first and kept the Latin ending.
items.cn: alga 属第一变格法，其主格复数为 algae；英语先借入复数形式，并保留了这个拉丁语词尾。

items.en: Algae enters English in the seventeenth century as a learned Latin plural, at first in botanical and medical writing.
items.cn: algae 于 17 世纪作为学术性的拉丁复数进入英语，最早见于植物学与医学写作。

items.en: In the nineteenth century algae became the name of a major group in botany, contrasted with fungi, and the singular alga was revived for a single organism.
items.cn: 到 19 世纪，algae 成为植物学中一个主要类群的名称，与真菌相对；单数 alga 也被重新启用，指单个藻体。

items.en: In the twentieth century the word spread from taxonomy to water management, aquaculture and fuel research, where it is often treated as a mass noun.
items.cn: 20 世纪，这个词从分类学扩散到水质管理、水产养殖与燃料研究，在这些领域常被当作不可数名词使用。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper origin and exact first date): the pre-Latin source of alga is unknown, and the first English citation is only approximate; any Indo-European form proposed for alga is a reconstruction.
items.cn: 来源不确定（更深词源与确切首见年代）：alga 在拉丁语之前的来源不明，最早的英语书证只能给约数；凡为 alga 提出的印欧语词形均属重构形式。

note.en: Group one holds words that look like algae or share its Latin stem, some genuinely related and one not; group two holds field terms whose scope is narrower or different.
note.cn: 第一组是与 algae 形近或共享拉丁词干的词，其中有真同源，也有纯属形近；第二组是范围更窄或所指不同的同领域术语。

entries.definition: The singular of algae, used for one individual thallus; the plural in -ae is the form English borrowed first.
entries.definitionCN: algae 的单数形式，指一个单独的藻体；英语最早借入的其实是 -ae 的复数形式。

entries.definition: An English adjective meaning 'of or relating to algae', formed from alga plus -al; it is neither a plural nor a species name.
entries.definitionCN: 英语形容词，意为「藻的、与藻有关的」，由 alga 加 -al 构成；它既不是复数，也不是物种名。

entries.definition: A salt of alginic acid extracted from brown algae and used as a thickener; it is a substance made from algae, not another name for them.
entries.definitionCN: 从褐藻中提取的褐藻酸盐，用作增稠剂；它是用藻做出的物质，而非藻的别称。

entries.definition: Cold or chilly, from Latin algere 'to be cold'; it resembles alga- in spelling but has no connection with algae.
entries.definitionCN: 意为寒冷的，来自拉丁 algere「发冷」；拼写与 alga- 相近，但与藻类毫无关系。

entries.definition: The everyday term for large marine algae seen on shores; it excludes most single-celled forms, which algae includes.
entries.definitionCN: 指海岸上见到的大型海生藻类的日常说法；它排除多数单细胞形态，而 algae 包含这些。

entries.definition: Microscopic algae, cultured or counted individually; it is a size-based part of the broader group.
entries.definitionCN: 微小的藻，可培养或逐个计数；它是更大类群中按体径划分的一部分。

entries.definition: Photosynthetic bacteria formerly classed as blue-green algae; under modern classification they are not true algae.
entries.definitionCN: 过去被归为蓝藻的光合细菌；按现代分类它们并非真正的藻类。

entries.definition: The drifting, photosynthetic members of the algae along with cyanobacteria; it selects by lifestyle, not by taxonomy.
entries.definitionCN: 藻类中漂移且行光合作用的成员，并包括蓝细菌；它按生活方式而非分类来选取。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real stems, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的词干、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: Algae is a plural in -ae, so one organism is an alga and two are algae; the adjective is algal.
normal.cn: algae 是以 -ae 结尾的复数，因此一个藻体是 alga，两个才是 algae；形容词是 algal。

normal.en: Colour names organise the group: green, red and brown algae differ in pigments and storage products.
normal.cn: 颜色名把这一类群分成几支：绿藻、红藻与褐藻的色素与储藏物质不同。

normal.en: Blue-green algae is the old name for cyanobacteria, which are bacteria and not algae at all.
normal.cn: blue-green algae 是蓝细菌的旧名，而蓝细菌属于细菌，根本不是藻。

normal.en: Algal bloom is the standard technical phrase; algae bloom is the looser everyday variant.
normal.cn: algal bloom 是标准技术说法；algae bloom 是较松散的日常变体。

normal.en: Alginate from brown algae thickens ice cream, and algaculture now grows algae for fuel and feed.
normal.cn: 褐藻来的褐藻胶给冰淇淋增稠，藻类养殖则为燃料与饲料培养藻。

abstract.en: Picture a wet rock painted with a thin green skin that no one notices until it slips.
abstract.cn: 想象一块湿石头被涂上一层薄薄的绿皮，没人注意，直到踩上去打滑。

abstract.en: Picture a pond turning soup-green overnight while the fish gasp at the surface.
abstract.cn: 想象池塘一夜之间变成汤一样的绿色，鱼在水面喘气。

abstract.en: Picture a coral animal farming tiny green cells inside its own tissue.
abstract.cn: 想象一只珊瑚动物在自己的组织里种着微小的绿色细胞。

examples.en: Algae range from single cells to kelps tens of metres long.
examples.cn: 藻类从单细胞到数十米长的海带都有。

examples.en: The aquarium glass was thick with green algae within a month.
examples.cn: 一个月内水族箱玻璃上就长满了厚厚的绿藻。

examples.en: Researchers grow algae in open ponds to produce oil.
examples.cn: 研究者在露天池塘中培养藻类以生产油脂。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「algae」读似「爱尔吉」——海藻爱在水里长、爱在石上滑；纯属谐音，非词源

root: 拉丁语 alga「海藻、水草」的复数 algae；alga 的更深来源不确定，无公认的印欧语语源，与其它语言中「海藻」词的比较均属假说。英语 17 世纪借入，单数 alga，复数按拉丁第一变格法 -a → -ae。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one image: a green film on a wet surface, repeated at every scale. The group is named first, then the single cell, then the seaweed, the freshwater form, the bloom, the crop, the symbiont and finally the fossil.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一个意象展开：湿表面上的一层绿膜，在各个尺度上重复。先指整个类群，再指单细胞、大型海藻、淡水藻，然后是藻华、养殖作物、共生体，最后是化石。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a green film that lives where water stays.
core.cn: 核心意象：一层绿膜，长在水停留的地方。

branches.en: The green film of simple cells on stone or still water.
branches.cn: 石头或静水上简单细胞形成的绿膜。

branches.en: Large seaweeds in the ocean and fine algae in fresh water.
branches.cn: 海洋里的大型海藻与淡水中的细小藻类。

branches.en: A bloom: algae multiplying until they color the water.
branches.cn: 藻华：藻类大量繁殖使水变色。

branches.en: Algae living inside corals or lichens as partners.
branches.cn: 藻类与珊瑚、地衣共生的伙伴关系。

branches.en: Biofuel and food uses of farmed algae.
branches.cn: 养殖藻类用于生物燃料与食品。

intro.en: Algae is a Latin noun borrowed whole, so its family is built from the Latin stem alg- plus English suffixes and combining forms.
intro.cn: algae 是整体借入的拉丁名词，因此其词族由拉丁词干 alg- 加英语后缀与构词成分构成。

latinIntro.en: Latin alga 'seaweed, water plant' gives the English singular alga and the plural algae; the same stem appears in the adjective algal and in alginate, named from alginic acid. The pre-Latin origin of alga is unknown, so no further Latin relative is listed.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 alga「海藻、水草」给出英语单数 alga 与复数 algae；同一词干还见于形容词 algal 与得名于褐藻酸的 alginate。alga 在拉丁语之前的来源不明，因此不再列出更远的拉丁同族词。

items.example: Alga is the singular used for one thallus.
items.exampleCN: alga 是单数，指一个藻体。

items.example: Algae is the plural form that English borrowed.
items.exampleCN: algae 是英语借入的复数形式。

items.example: Algal mats cover the rock surface.
Algology began as a branch of botany.
items.exampleCN: 藻类学最初是植物学的一个分支。

items.example: An algologist identified the bloom species.
items.exampleCN: 一位藻类学家鉴定出了藻华的物种。

items.meaning: a salt of alginic acid from brown algae
items.meaningCN: 褐藻中提取的褐藻酸盐

items.exampleCN: 藻类养殖提供饲料与燃料。

items.example: Copper sulfate serves as an algicide in reservoirs.
items.exampleCN: 硫酸铜在水库里用作杀藻剂。

items.example: Microalgae are grown in closed reactors.
items.exampleCN: 微藻在密闭反应器中培养。

latinEntries.example: Latin alga names the plant cast up on the shore.
latinEntries.exampleCN: 拉丁 alga 指被冲上岸的水生植物。

latinEntries.example: The Latin plural algae passed into English unchanged.
latinEntries.exampleCN: 拉丁复数 algae 原样进入了英语。

definition_zh: 代数；代数学；代数体系
definition_en: a branch of mathematics in which letters and symbols stand for unknown numbers
core_image: 黑板上字母代替未知数，等式像天平两边保持平衡
scene: 老师把未知数写成字母，让学生一步步解出它的值。In algebra, letters stand for numbers we do not yet know.
sceneCN: 这里 algebra 是「代数」（第 1 个义项：用符号代替数的数学分支）；句意为在代数里，字母代表我们还不知道的数。

pos.zh: 名词：代数；代数学；代数体系

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -ic 构成，义为「代数的；代数式的」
由 algebraic 加 -ly 构成，义为「用代数方法地」
由本词加 -ist 构成，义为「代数学家」

senses.title: The branch of mathematics
senses.definition: the branch of mathematics that uses letters and symbols to represent numbers and solve equations
senses.definitionCN: 用字母和符号表示数并解方程的数学分支
senses.example: She started studying algebra at the age of twelve.
senses.exampleCN: 她十二岁开始学代数。
senses.why: The Arabic name meant the reunion of broken parts, and the subject is exactly that: pieces of a problem are put back together through symbols.
senses.whyCN: 这个阿拉伯语名称意为「破碎部分的重聚」，而这门学科做的正是这件事：用符号把问题的碎片重新拼合。

senses.title: A system of symbolic rules
senses.definition: a particular system of symbols and operations, such as Boolean algebra or linear algebra
senses.definitionCN: 一套特定的符号与运算体系，如布尔代数或线性代数
senses.example: Boolean algebra uses two values, true and false.
senses.exampleCN: 布尔代数使用真与假两个值。
senses.why: Once the method exists, each set of rules can be called an algebra, the way each language has its own grammar.
senses.whyCN: 方法一旦存在，每一套规则都可以称为一种代数，就像每种语言都有自己的语法。

senses.title: Schoolwork with unknowns
senses.definition: the school activity of solving problems with unknown quantities represented by letters
senses.definitionCN: 用字母代表未知量来解题的学校课业
senses.example: He spent the evening doing algebra before the test.
senses.exampleCN: 考试前他一晚上都在做代数题。
senses.why: In everyday school talk the subject name also names the exercise, because the practice is the subject for the student.
senses.whyCN: 在日常校园说法里，学科名也指练习题，因为对学生而言，做题就是这门学科。

intro.en: Algebra carries an Arabic name for restoring broken pieces, a name that describes the method itself.
intro.cn: algebra 带着一个阿拉伯语名称，意为「修复破碎的部分」，这个名称描述的正是方法本身。

items.en: Arabic al-jabr meant the restoring or reunion of broken parts, a term used for setting broken bones.
items.cn: 阿拉伯语 al-jabr 意为修复或重聚破碎的部分，也曾用于接骨。

items.en: The root jabr supplied the idea of forcing something back into place, which became the operation of moving terms across an equation.
items.cn: 词根 jabr 提供「把某物强行归位」的观念，后来成为等式两边移项运算的名称。

items.en: Medieval Latin borrowed the term as algebra, the name of the calculation method in Arabic mathematics.
items.cn: 中世纪拉丁语借入作 algebra，指阿拉伯数学中这套计算方法的名称。

items.en: Old French passed the word to English, where it named the new art of calculation with unknowns.
items.cn: 古法语把这个词传给英语，用来命名用未知数计算的新技艺。

items.en: English algebra is recorded in the sixteenth century, first as the name of the method rather than the school subject.
items.cn: 英语 algebra 在十六世纪有记录，最初指方法名称，而不是学校科目。

items.en: Modern mathematics widened the word to cover many symbolic systems, from linear to abstract algebra.
items.cn: 现代数学扩大了这个词，使之涵盖从线性代数到抽象代数的众多符号体系。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the algebra family; the near-meaning group gathers neighbouring branches of mathematics.
note.cn: 形近组收 algebra 词族；近义组收相邻的数学分支。

entries.definition: Relating to algebra or to symbolic calculation.
entries.definitionCN: 指与代数或符号计算有关的。

entries.definition: By means of algebra rather than by a graph.
entries.definitionCN: 指用代数方法而不是用图象来解。

entries.definition: A person who works on algebra.
entries.definitionCN: 指研究代数的人。

entries.definition: The basic mathematics of numbers and ordinary operations.
entries.definitionCN: 指关于数与普通运算的基础数学。

entries.definition: The mathematics of shape, size and position.
entries.definitionCN: 指关于形状、大小与位置的数学。

entries.definition: The mathematics of continuous change, built on algebra.
entries.definitionCN: 指研究连续变化的数学，建立在代数之上。

normalIntro.en: These hooks tie the Arabic meaning of reuniting pieces to the visible work of solving.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子把阿拉伯语「重聚碎片」的含义，系到看得见的解题动作上。

normal.en: Algebra literally means reuniting broken parts, which is what moving terms does.
normal.cn: algebra 字面意思是把破碎部分重新拼合，这正是移项在做的事。

normal.en: Letters stand in for numbers, so an equation is a sentence with blank spaces.
normal.cn: 字母代替数字，所以一个等式就是一句留有空格的句子。

normal.en: Linear algebra is the algebra of lines and vectors.
normal.cn: linear algebra 是线和向量的代数。

normal.en: Boolean algebra borrows the method for true and false instead of numbers.
normal.cn: 布尔代数把同一方法借去处理真与假，而不是数字。

normal.en: An algebra problem is a broken bone of numbers, waiting to be set back into place.
normal.cn: 一道代数题就是数字的断骨，等着被接回原位。

abstract.en: Picture a broken plate on a table, with the pieces numbered and scattered.
abstract.cn: 想象桌上有一只碎盘子，碎片编号后散落着。

abstract.en: Each equation is a rule for which pieces may be moved next to which.
abstract.cn: 每个等式都是一条规则，说明哪块碎片可以挪到哪块旁边。

abstract.en: When the pieces fit again, the value of the unknown appears in the last joint.
abstract.cn: 碎片重新合上时，未知数的值就显现在最后一道接缝里。

examples.en: Algebra taught her to solve for an unknown step by step.
examples.cn: 代数教会她一步步解出未知数。

examples.en: The engineer used linear algebra to model the bridge.
examples.cn: 工程师用线性代数给这座桥建模。

examples.en: He found the algebra test harder than geometry.
examples.cn: 他觉得代数测验比几何难。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「二姐不惹」——二姐不惹代数题，一见字母就头疼

root: 源自阿拉伯语 al-jabr「修复、重聚破碎部分」（原也指接骨），经中世纪拉丁语 algebra 与古法语 algebre 进入英语；指用符号把问题的碎片重新拼合的数学方法。

sensesIntro.en: The three senses move from the mathematical branch, to a particular symbolic system, to the school exercise that teaches it.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项从数学分支，走到特定的符号体系，再到教授这门学问的学校练习。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: broken pieces lie on a table, and a rule tells you how to join them until the missing piece appears.
core.cn: 核心意象：破碎的片块散在桌上，一条规则告诉你怎么把它们接起来，直到缺失的一块现身。

branches.en: THE BONES: the Arabic name came from setting broken bones, and the subject still sets pieces back in place.
branches.cn: 接骨线：这个阿拉伯语名称来自接骨，而这门学科仍把碎片接回原位。

branches.en: THE LETTER: a symbol takes the place of a number we do not know yet.
branches.cn: 字母线：一个符号代替我们还不知道的数。

branches.en: THE SYSTEM: each set of symbols and operations becomes an algebra of its own.
branches.cn: 体系线：每一套符号与运算都成为它自己的一种代数。

branches.en: THE CLASSROOM: the name slides from the subject to the exercises done at a desk.
branches.cn: 课堂线：名称从学科滑到课桌上做的练习题。

branches.en: THE RULE: what all algebras share is a rule for moving symbols without changing the balance.
branches.cn: 规则线：所有代数共享的是同一类规则，在不破坏平衡的前提下移动符号。

intro.en: Algebra is an Arabic loanword with a productive English suffix family; the compounds name branches of the subject.
intro.cn: algebra 是阿拉伯语借词，英语给它长出了能产的后缀词族；复合词则命名各分支。

latinIntro.en: The word reached English through medieval Latin, but its base is Arabic, so Latin family entries are limited.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词经中世纪拉丁语进入英语，但词基来自阿拉伯语，因此拉丁同族条目有限。

items.meaningCN: 用符号表示未知数的数学
items.example: Algebra is taught in middle school.
The Arabic term also meant bone setting.
items.exampleCN: 这个阿拉伯语词也曾指接骨。

items.example: It forms algebraical, an older variant.
items.exampleCN: 它构成较早的变体 algebraical。

items.example: Linear algebra is used in computer graphics.
items.exampleCN: 线性代数用于计算机图形学。

items.meaning: algebra of true and false values
items.exampleCN: 布尔代数是数字电路的基础。

definition_zh: 外国的；陌生的；格格不入的；外国人；外星人
definition_en: belonging to another country, strange and unfamiliar, or a person from another country or planet
core_image: 一个人站在热闹的街口，四周的话他一句也听不懂
scene: 夜市里人声鼎沸，他站在摊子前，听不懂旁边的人在说什么。The customs officer asked whether he was an alien or a resident.
sceneCN: 这里 alien 是「外国人、外侨」（第 4 个义项：法律意义上不属本国的人）；句意为海关人员问他是外侨还是居民。图中可辨识物件：夜市摊子、行李箱、证件。

pos.zh: 形容词：外国的；陌生的；格格不入的
名词：外国人；外侨；外星人

derivatives.zh: 由本词加动词后缀构成，义为「使疏远；使格格不入」
由 alienate 加名词后缀构成，义为「疏离；异化」
由本词加名词后缀构成，义为「陌生感；异质性」

senses.title: Belonging to another country
senses.definition: belonging to or coming from a country that is not one's own
senses.definitionCN: 属于或来自非本国的国家
senses.example: The plant is an alien species that spread along the river.
senses.exampleCN: 这种植物是沿河扩散的外来物种。
senses.why: Latin alienus meant 'belonging to another', so the word marks anything that belongs to someone else's place.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 alienus 意为「属于他人的」，所以这个词标记的是归属于别人那处地方的东西。

senses.title: Strange and unwelcome
senses.definition: strange, unfamiliar, and therefore difficult to accept or fit into
senses.definitionCN: 陌生、不熟悉，因此难以接受或融入
senses.example: The rules felt alien to everything she had been taught.
senses.exampleCN: 这些规则与她所受的一切教导都格格不入。
senses.why: What belongs elsewhere can also feel wrong here, so the word shifted from ownership to emotional distance.
senses.whyCN: 属于别处的东西，在这里也可能让人觉得不对劲，于是这个词从「归属」转向了情感上的距离。

senses.title: A being from another planet
senses.definition: in science fiction, a creature from another planet
senses.definitionCN: 科幻作品里来自其他星球的生物
senses.example: The film shows an alien learning to speak through music.
senses.exampleCN: 这部影片讲一个外星人通过音乐学会说话。
senses.why: Twentieth-century science fiction reused the legal word for a foreigner and moved the border from a country to a planet.
senses.whyCN: 二十世纪科幻沿用了这个法律词，把边界从国界搬到了星球之间。

senses.title: A foreign national, in law
senses.definition: in law, a person who is not a citizen of the country in which they are
senses.definitionCN: 法律上不属所在国公民的人
senses.example: The customs officer asked whether he was an alien or a resident.
senses.exampleCN: 海关人员问他是外侨还是居民。
senses.why: Legal writing needed a neutral term for non-citizens, and the old adjective supplied it; the usage is now often replaced by foreign national.
senses.whyCN: 法律文书需要一个中性词指非公民，这个古老形容词正好补位；如今这一用法多被 foreign national 取代。

intro.en: Alien goes back to a Latin word for 'belonging to another', and every sense still turns on that idea of elsewhere.
intro.cn: alien 可追到拉丁语中意为「属于他人」的词，所有义项都围绕「属于别处」这个念头。

items.en: Alius meant 'other', the root of alias, alter and alien alike.
items.cn: alius 意为「其他的」，alias、alter 与 alien 都出自这个词。

items.en: Alienus meant 'belonging to another, foreign', and could describe both persons and things.
items.cn: alienus 意为「属于他人的、外来的」，既可形容人也可形容物。

items.en: French carried the word into law and diplomacy, where it named a person outside the community.
items.cn: 法语把这个词带入法律与外交，用来指群体之外的人。

items.en: English uses alien from the fourteenth century for foreigners and for things that do not belong.
items.cn: 英语自十四世纪起用 alien 指外国人，也指不属于本地的事物。

items.en: Science fiction added the planetary sense in the twentieth century, and the legal sense has since softened.
items.cn: 科幻在二十世纪加入「外星」义，法律义此后逐渐软化。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words from the same 'other' root; the near-meaning group gathers outsiders and unfamiliar things.
note.cn: 形近组收同一「其他」词根的词；近义组收外来者与陌生事物。

entries.definition: To make someone feel unwelcome or distant.
entries.definitionCN: 使某人感到不受欢迎或疏远。

entries.definition: The feeling of being cut off from a group or from oneself.
entries.definitionCN: 与群体或与自我割裂的感觉。

entries.definition: A false name used by a person.
entries.definitionCN: 一个人使用的化名。

entries.definition: Belonging to a country other than one's own.
entries.definitionCN: 属于本国之外的国家。

entries.definition: A person one does not know.
entries.definitionCN: 不认识的人。

entries.definition: Unfamiliar in a way that is interesting rather than threatening.
entries.definitionCN: 陌生但有趣，而非令人不安的。

normalIntro.en: Two real parts carry the word: Latin alius, 'other', and the adjective ending -enus.
normalIntro.cn: 两个真实部件承载这个词：拉丁语 alius「其他的」与形容词词尾 -enus。

normal.en: Alien, alias and alter all begin with the same idea: the other one.
normal.cn: alien、alias、alter 都从同一个念头开始：另一个。

normal.en: Alien to means foreign to, and it is the phrase that carries the emotional sense.
normal.cn: alien to 意为「与……格格不入」，情绪义就藏在这个搭配里。

normal.en: The legal noun is neutral, the science-fiction noun is exciting: context does the work.
normal.cn: 法律名词是中性的，科幻名词是刺激的：意义由语境完成。

normal.en: The stress is on the first syllable: A-li-en.
normal.cn: 重音在第一个音节：A-li-en。

normal.en: Keep the i before the e: a-l-i-e-n.
normal.cn: 注意 i 在 e 前：a-l-i-e-n。

abstract.en: A word for 'belonging to another' can describe a plant, a law, a feeling and a planet, because otherness takes many forms.
abstract.cn: 一个「属于他人」的词既能形容植物、法律、感受，也能形容星球，因为「他者」有许多形态。

abstract.en: The same word that excludes can also fascinate, which is why alien and exotic sit so close together.
abstract.cn: 同一个用于排斥的词也能令人着迷，所以 alien 与 exotic 靠得那么近。

abstract.en: Calling someone an alien is always a statement about the border, not about the person.
abstract.cn: 把某人称作 alien，说的永远是边界，而不是那个人。

examples.en: The customs officer asked whether he was an alien or a resident.
examples.cn: 海关人员问他是外侨还是居民。

examples.en: The rules felt alien to everything she had been taught.
examples.cn: 这些规则与她所受的一切教导都格格不入。

examples.en: The film shows an alien learning to speak through music.
examples.cn: 这部影片讲一个外星人通过音乐学会说话。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「爱连」——爱连家乡都不认识他，他成了这里的外人。

root: 源自拉丁语 alienus「属于他人的、外来的」，其词根 alius 意为「其他的」。

sensesIntro.en: One idea of elsewhere runs through all four senses: another country, another culture, another planet, and the legal line drawn around a community.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项贯穿着同一个「别处」：别的国家、别的文化、别的星球，以及围绕共同体划下的那条法律界线。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a traveller stands at a busy corner and understands not one word around him.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个旅人站在热闹的街口，周围的话一句也听不懂。

branches.en: a plant that spreads where it was never native
branches.cn: 在并非原生之地蔓延的植物

branches.en: a rule book written in a language of its own
branches.cn: 用另一套语言写成的规则手册

branches.en: a light crossing the sky too fast to be a plane
branches.cn: 快得不像飞机的天上光点

branches.en: a form with two boxes: citizen and other
branches.cn: 只有「公民」与「其他」两栏的表格

branches.en: one outside position, felt and also filed
branches.cn: 同一个「在外」的位置，既被感受，也被归档

intro.en: A Latin root for 'other', its adjective, and the English endings that build the family.
intro.cn: 一个意为「其他」的拉丁词根、它的形容词形式，以及构成词族的英语词尾。

latinIntro.en: alius and alienus are recorded Latin; the deeper Indo-European root is reconstructed.
latinIntro.cn: alius 与 alienus 都是有文献记录的拉丁词，更早的印欧词根属重构。

items.meaning: the state of being cut off

definition_zh: 使疏远；使不友好；离间；（法律）转让（财产、权利）
definition_en: to make someone who was friendly or loyal become cold or hostile; in law, to transfer property or a right to another person
core_image: 把原本属于自己的人推到门外去
scene: 他一句玩笑得罪了半个团队，从此没人愿意跟他搭档。His sarcasm began to alienate his closest colleagues.
sceneCN: 这里 alienate 是「使疏远」（第 1 个义项：让人从亲近转为冷淡或敌对）；句意为他的讥讽开始让最亲近的同事疏远他。核心画面是把原本属于自己的人推到门外去。

pos.zh: 使疏远；使不友好；离间；转让

derivatives.zh: 加 -ion 构成，义为「疏远；异化」
过去分词作形容词，义为「感到被疏远的」
同根形容词，义为「外国的；陌生的」

senses.title: To turn closeness into distance
senses.definition: to make someone who was friendly or loyal become cold, hostile or withdrawn, usually by your own behaviour
senses.definitionCN: 让原本友好或忠诚的人变得冷淡、敌对或退缩，通常由自己的行为造成
senses.example: The new rules alienated the very staff they were meant to help.
senses.exampleCN: 新规定反而让本该受照顾的员工疏远了。
senses.why: Alien means belonging to another, so alienate is to make someone into an outsider: you push a person who was yours across the boundary.
senses.whyCN: alien 意为「属于别人的」，所以 alienate 就是把某人变成外人：你把原本属于自己的人推过了界线。

senses.title: To transfer ownership away
senses.definition: in law, to transfer property or a right to another person, the older and technical sense of the word
senses.definitionCN: 法律上把财产或权利转移给他人，是该词更古老、更专业的用法
senses.example: The trust forbids the heir to alienate the estate.
senses.exampleCN: 信托禁止继承人转让这份地产。
senses.why: This is the literal core: to make a thing alien, that is, the property of someone else, which is exactly what a legal transfer does.
senses.whyCN: 这是字面核心：让某物变成 alien「别人的」，而法律上的转让做的正是这件事。

intro.en: Alienate comes straight from Latin alienus, belonging to another: to alienate is to make someone or something into the property of another, whether the loyalty of a friend or a piece of land.
intro.cn: alienate 直接来自拉丁语 alienus「属于别人的」：alienate 就是把某人或某物变成别人的，无论是朋友的忠诚还是一块土地。

items.en: Latin alius meant other or another, the root behind alias, alibi and alter.
items.cn: 拉丁语 alius 意为「其他、另一个」，是 alias、alibi 与 alter 背后的词根。

items.en: From alius came alienus, belonging to another person, hence foreign or strange.
items.cn: 由 alius 派生出 alienus「属于别人的」，因此引申为外国的、陌生的。

items.en: The verb alienare meant to transfer ownership, and also to estrange the affection of a person.
items.cn: 动词 alienare 意为转移所有权，也指使人的感情疏远。

items.en: Its past participle alienatus carried both senses, legal transfer and emotional estrangement.
items.cn: 其过去分词 alienatus 同时承载两义：法律转让与感情疏远。

items.en: English borrowed the word in the fourteenth century, first in law and soon after in descriptions of friendship.
items.cn: 英语在十四世纪借入该词，先用于法律，随后用于描述友情。

items.en: Modern use favours the emotional sense, while the legal sense survives in deeds and in the noun alienation.
items.cn: 现代用法偏重感情义，法律义则保留在契据与名词 alienation 中。

note.en: The look-alike group keeps the ali- family of otherness; the near-meaning group lists other verbs for pushing people away.
note.cn: 形近组保留表示「他者」的 ali- 词族；近义组列出其他表示「把人推开」的动词。

entries.definition: Belonging to another place or person.
entries.definitionCN: 属于别处或别人的。

entries.definition: The state of being isolated or estranged.
entries.definitionCN: 被孤立或疏远的状态。

entries.definition: A false or alternative name.
entries.definitionCN: 假名或别名。

entries.definition: A claim of being elsewhere when a crime occurred.
entries.definitionCN: 声称案发时身在别处的说法。

entries.definition: To cause someone to become unfriendly.
entries.definitionCN: 使某人变得不友好。

entries.definition: To keep yourself apart from someone.
entries.definitionCN: 让自己与某人保持距离。

entries.definition: To leave someone alone and unsupported.
entries.definitionCN: 让某人孤立无援。

entries.definition: To make someone lose loyalty.
entries.definitionCN: 使某人失去忠诚。

normalIntro.en: Alienate is alien plus -ate: to make someone alien, an outsider, to you.
normalIntro.cn: alienate 就是 alien 加 -ate：把某人变成 alien，即变成你的外人。

normal.en: Alien means other, so alienate means to make other: the friend becomes a stranger.
normal.cn: alien 意为「他者」，所以 alienate 就是「使他者化」：朋友变成了陌生人。

normal.en: -ate turns the adjective into a verb, as in activate and isolate.
normal.cn: -ate 把形容词变成动词，如 activate、isolate。

normal.en: You alienate someone by your behaviour; you feel alienated by theirs.
normal.cn: 你的行为让别人疏远你；别人的行为让你感到被疏远。

normal.en: In law alienate simply means transfer, so alienate property is sell or give it away.
normal.cn: 法律上 alienate 就是转让，所以 alienate property 是卖掉或送出财产。

normal.en: The noun is alienation, not alienment: remember the -ation ending.
normal.cn: 名词是 alienation，不是 alienment：记住 -ation 这个词尾。

abstract.en: Picture a friend stepping across a line drawn on the floor and not coming back.
abstract.cn: 想象一个朋友跨过地上画的一条线，再也没有回来。

abstract.en: Imagine a door closing slowly between two people who used to share a room.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇门在两个曾同住一屋的人之间缓缓关上。

abstract.en: Think of a deed handing your land to the name of a stranger.
abstract.cn: 想象一纸契据把你的土地转到一个陌生人名下。

examples.en: Constant criticism will alienate even your supporters.
examples.cn: 不断的批评连你的支持者也会疏远。

examples.en: She felt alienated by the office gossip.
examples.cn: 办公室的闲言碎语让她感到被疏远。

examples.en: The clause prevents the owner from alienating the land.
examples.cn: 该条款阻止业主转让这块土地。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「诶里诶内特」——诶（a）里（li）诶（e）内特（nate）：把里面的人推到外面去，就是使疏远、离间。

root: 拉丁语 alius「其他」派生出 alienus「属于别人的」，加动词后缀构成 alienare「转让、使疏远」，其过去分词 alienatus 经中古英语 alienaten 进入现代英语成为 alienate，字面即「使成为他者」。

sensesIntro.en: Both senses move something across a boundary: the emotional one pushes a person out of your circle, and the legal one pushes a property out of your name.
sensesIntro.cn: 两个义项都是把某样东西推过界线：感情义把人推出你的圈子，法律义把财产推出你的名下。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: pushing what was yours across the boundary
core.cn: 核心意象：把原本属于你的推过界线

branches.en: A joke that costs you a friend.
branches.cn: 一个让你失去朋友的玩笑。

branches.en: Rules that push loyal staff away.
branches.cn: 把忠诚员工推开的规定。

branches.en: A deed that moves land to a new name.
branches.cn: 把土地转到新名下的契据。

branches.en: A right signed over to another party.
branches.cn: 签字让给另一方的权利。

branches.en: Both make what was yours into the property of another.
branches.cn: 两者都把原本属于你的变成别人的。

intro.en: Alienate keeps the ali- root of otherness and adds -ate to make a verb, with -ation available for the resulting state.
intro.cn: alienate 保留表示「他者」的 ali- 词根，加 -ate 构成动词，并可用 -ation 表示由此产生的状态。

latinIntro.en: Latin alius gave alienus, alienare and alienatus; English took the participle and kept both of its senses.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 alius 派生出 alienus、alienare 与 alienatus；英语取用其分词，并保留了它的两个义项。

latinEntries.example: Alius is the root of the ali- family.
latinEntries.exampleCN: alius 是 ali- 词族的词根。

latinEntries.example: Alienus gives alien and alienate.
latinEntries.exampleCN: alienus 产生 alien 与 alienate。

latinEntries.example: Alienare carried both senses.
latinEntries.exampleCN: alienare 同时承载两义。

latinEntries.example: Alienatus is the direct source of alienate.
latinEntries.exampleCN: alienatus 是 alienate 的直接来源。
